title: Mpemba effect as an entropy-production race:Finite-amplitude bounds on crossing times in Markovian relaxation
abstract: Two canonical preparations evolving under a common final Markov generator can exhibit the Mpemba effect because they excite different relaxation modes. We bound the first crossing of their relative entropies by treating relaxation as an entropy-production race. The exact balance $-\dot D=\dot e_p$ implies that a meeting occurs when the accumulated \emph{difference} of normalized entropy-production rates, $\int_0^t(r_H-r_C)\,\mathrm ds$ with $r_\alpha=\dot e_p^{\alpha}/D_\alpha$, equals the initial logarithmic deficit $\ln[D_H(0)/D_C(0)]$. Global entropy-decay inequalities yield a lower crossing-time bound when the entropy-decay constant is bounded from below and the hot rate from above; we supply both certificates. A nonzero cubic moment of a slowest eigenfunction is sufficient for the modified logarithmic Sobolev constant to lie strictly below the spectral gap. Combining established relative-entropy comparison inequalities with Markov contraction and the actual mode amplitudes gives finite-amplitude crossing bounds without a small-deviation expansion. For an exactly strong, reversible three-state preparation these give $0.1659\le t_M\le0.1674$ in model time units, independently certified by outward-rounded interval arithmetic. This interval is narrower than $1\%$ and contains $t_M=0.1662209$. The conservative global-rate comparison used here gives only $t_M\ge0.042$. The hotter preparation starts $6.12$ times farther from equilibrium, yet it reaches $D=10^{-5}$ at $t=0.233$, compared with $t=0.844$ for the colder one. Mean energy crosses later than relative entropy. For a fixed driven generator, nonadiabatic entropy production governs the same balance. These results concern finite-state relaxation in a specified distance and do not predict water-freezing times.
summary:
1. 针对同一有限态马尔可夫生成元下冷热正则初态的相对熵首次交叉，作者结合熵耗散恒等式、模态振幅与收缩性，构造无需近平衡展开的时间界。
2. 在热态最慢模精确消除的可逆三态模型中，区间运算认证首次交叉时间位于0.1659—0.1674模型时间单位内，而所用全局速率界仅给出0.042的下限。
3. 这些界限可在少态淬火实验中检验，但含制备误差或更多模态的系统仍需修改包络，且相对熵与能量的交叉不必同步。

title: SKFitter: Symmetry resolved Slater Koster tight-binding models from first principles for s, p, d and f electrons, spin orbit coupling and magnetism
abstract: Constructing accurate and physically interpretable tight binding (TB) Hamiltonians from first principles calculations remains challenging, particularly for materials exhibiting complex orbital hybridization, spin orbit coupling (SOC), and magnetic order. SKFitter is an open-source Python framework for constructing and optimizing symmetry resolved Slater Koster TB models directly from density functional theory (DFT) calculations performed using Quantum ESPRESSO or VASP. The framework supports s to f orbitals, incorporates on site SOC and site resolved magnetic exchange interactions, and accommodates both orthogonal and nonorthogonal basis. A central feature is the symmetry resolved parameterization of orbital manifolds, which allows independent two centre hopping integrals between symmetry allowed orbital groups and across distinct neighbour shells. SKFitter also identifies missing orbital contributions and guide systematic basis set refinement and optimizes parameters through weights. The resulting Hamiltonian can be used to evaluate anomalous (AHC) and spin Hall conductivities (SHC), and topological invariants. We demonstrate the framework using eight representative materials spanning semimetals, semiconductors, transition metals, f-electron compounds, and magnetic systems. Symmetry resolved models achieve band energy errors of 9 to 41 meV within 1 eV of the Fermi level. The fitted Hamiltonians reproduce characteristic features of the SHC response of Pt, the SOC dependence of the AHC of Fe, and the momentum dependent altermagnetic spin splitting of MnTe without any altermagnet specific interaction. For EuMn2Bi2, projection guided orbital refinement reduces the near Fermi level fitting error from 120 to 32 meV. Together, these results establish SKFitter as a flexible and reproducible framework for developing symmetry consistent, physically interpretable TB models of complex materials.
summary:
1. 为兼顾复杂磁体建模的精度与可解释性，作者开发SKFitter，以对称性分组的s至f轨道构建含在位自旋轨道耦合和逐位点交换的Slater–Koster模型，并加权拟合DFT能带。
2. 八种材料在费米能±1 eV内的能带均方根误差为9–41 meV，MnTe无需交错磁专用项即给出594 meV的价带自旋劈裂，接近DFT的606 meV。
3. 该框架可支持磁性霍尔响应研究，但铁的反常霍尔电导仍低于参考值，非共线磁体的基准检验与量子输运扩展尚待开展。

title: Spectral properties of orthorhombic KSbOSiO$_4$ crystals: studies of infrared, visible and ultraviolet radiation absorption, Raman scattering, cathodoluminescence and photoluminescence
abstract: Crystals of orthorhombic KSbOSiO$_4$ (KSS) are often found to synthesize in glass of historical and artistic articles. For instance, these crystallites in the glass of turquoise Bohemian seed beads are known to play a significant role in the process of internal-stress driven corrosion of the glass causing deterioration and destruction of bead embroidered museum exhibits, especially articles made in the early 19th century. In art materials science, KSS has been known since the mid-2010s only for its destructive effects on historical glass objects, but as an optical material it has long been studied. KSS belongs to the group of compounds isomorphic to KTiOPO$_4$ (KTP) and, like other compounds from this group, has anomalies in dielectric constant. The article presents the results of a study of orthorhombic KSS crystals using a number of spectroscopic techniques. IR absorption and diffuse reflection spectra of KSS in the spectral range from 50 to 4000~cm$^{-1}$, its Raman spectrum, its absorption spectrum in the range from near infrared to ultraviolet as well as its cathodoluminescence and photoluminescence spectra are investigated. The constituent peaks of the spectral bands are analyzed and their properties are summarized in tables; the allowed direct and indirect band gaps of KSS are determined. The presented data are necessary both for the correct spectral analysis of historical and artistic glass and enamels, during the production of which this substance was sometimes synthesized in glass, and for a more in-depth study of crystals of the KTP group.
summary:
1. 为厘清正交KSbOSiO4的晶格振动、带隙与发光来源，作者对合成单相粉末开展红外、拉曼、漫反射及阴极和光致发光测量。
2. 解析了17个红外吸收带的组分，并以Kubelka–Munk模型估得室温直接、间接允许带隙分别为5.02±0.02和3.93±0.01 eV。
3. 这些谱学指纹可辅助历史玻璃中该晶相的无损识别，但可见发光的缺陷或杂质深能级归属仍需微观验证。

title: Moiré metals and continuum models beyond a single valley
abstract: We derive continuum models of moiré materials valid over the full monolayer Brillouin zone, as required for metals whose large Fermi surfaces are not confined to a single valley. To this end, we introduce an environment-resolved two-center approximation, in which each hopping amplitude depends not only on the distance between the orbitals it connects but also on its position within the moiré cell. Taking the local environment to be set by the disregistry of the two layers alone, these moiré couplings and their full set of harmonics can be learnt from commensurate bilayers at uniform stackings, without fitting. The method shows excellent agreement with ab initio band structures on moiré cells containing a few hundred atoms. Applied to twisted NbSe$_2$, it yields a continuum model in which moiré effects concentrate at the van Hove singularities, a single-particle starting point for studying moiré-tuned superconducting, charge-density-wave instabilities and their competition.
summary:
1. 为突破莫尔金属大费米面的单谷描述限制，作者以环境分辨双中心近似，从均匀堆垛小原胞的第一性原理Wannier哈密顿量导出免拟合、保留完整动量依赖的全布里渊区连续模型。
2. 模型给出5.09°扭转WSe₂最高莫尔价带带宽102.1 meV（DFT为100.1 meV），并揭示NbSe₂的莫尔散射主要抑制范霍夫奇点处态密度。
3. 这为探索扭转调控超导与电荷密度波竞争提供单粒子起点，但面内弛豫和相互作用尚未纳入。

title: Singlet-Triplet Transition of Rotating Moiré Atoms in a Magnetic Field
abstract: Moiré superlattices can bind several electrons to each potential minimum, forming few-electron "moiré atoms." Using neural quantum states that obey magnetic periodic boundary conditions, include full Landau-level mixing, and treat both spin sectors, we map the ground state of two-electron moiré atoms in a superlattice as a function of moiré depth and magnetic field strength. At strong field each atom is a spin-triplet maximum-density droplet with canonical angular momentum $\langle L_z\rangle=-1$ and a persistent circulating current: the rotating counterpart of the "Wigner molecular crystal" recently imaged in moiré superlattices. Deepening the wells drives a singlet-triplet transition to non-rotating spin-singlet atoms whose only current is a weak diamagnetic counter-circulation. The transition moves to deeper wells as the field grows, so depth and field together open a window for the formation of rotors. This is the collective analog of the singlet-triplet transition of two-electron quantum dots. At the transition, the orbital magnetic moments of the atoms reverse sign as their spin polarization switches, a joint signature accessible to magnetometry. If the atoms are instead polarized by other means, such as magnetic proximity coupling, the rotors lock at weak field into a spontaneously ordered crystal of dimers in a pinwheel pattern.
summary:
1. 作者以满足磁周期边界、完整保留朗道能级混合的神经量子态比较两自旋扇区，绘制12个库仑耦合双电子莫尔原子的磁场—阱深相图。
2. 强场稳定每原子正则角动量约为−ℏ的三重态转子，加深势阱使其转为单重态并令轨道磁矩反号，临界阱深随磁场增强而增大。
3. 轨道磁矩反号尚待磁测量检验，而预测的弱场风车二聚体晶体需额外机制维持自旋极化才可能实现。

title: Theory of Convective Diffusion
abstract: We obtain a hydrodynamic theory of diffusive-scale dynamics in one-dimensional systems with interacting sound modes in the absence of self-interactions. Chaotic systems generically feature three distinct Gaussian relaxation processes: besides normal diffusion, driven by microscopic noise stemming from fast-decaying non-hydrodynamic modes, collisions between sound modes lead to two additional channels: convective diffusion manifesting as an effective multiplicative temporal noise, and an effective additive noise generated by the surrounding hydrodynamic modes. Our theory also includes, as a subclass, integrable systems described by generalized hydrodynamics, representing a pure realization of convective diffusion. Focusing on convective diffusion, we obtain an exact closed-form expression for the higher-point dynamical correlation functions and contrast their structure with those of normal diffusion. Additionally, we show that in convective diffusion each sound mode features a universal non-Gaussian distribution of charge transfer in its comoving frame, thereby establishing anomalous fluctuations as a characteristic feature of diffusive-scale dynamics in integrable systems.
summary:
1. 针对守恒流不含单模平方项的一维体系，作者消去背景声模，建立扩散尺度随机场理论，以乘性时间噪声描述对流扩散。
2. 在仅有对流扩散的可积体系中，导出高阶关联闭式解及共动系电荷转移的非高斯“嵌套高斯”分布，规则54模拟末期宽度参数与预测相差约1%。
3. 高阶统计可区分二点函数同为高斯的对流与普通扩散，但混沌体系的额外扩散通道会改变转移分布，完整的对流超扩散理论仍待建立。

title: Intertwined ferromagnetic and altermagnetic orders in Cr-doped MnTe
abstract: Ferromagnetism and altermagnetism both break time-reversal symmetry, yet their distinct transformation properties under crystalline symmetries forbid direct bilinear coupling between their order parameters. Whether these two magnetic orders can remain thermodynamically distinct while strongly influencing one another remains an open question. Here we demonstrate the homogeneous coexistence of ferromagnetism and altermagnetism in Cr-doped MnTe. By tuning the ferromagnetic ordering temperature across the nearly unchanged Néel temperature with Cr doping, we uncover a striking interplay between the two orders: the ferromagnetic transition becomes a crossover when altermagnetism develops first, whereas the onset of altermagnetism strongly suppresses the out-of-plane ferromagnetic remanence when ferromagnetism develops first. Moreover, spin-orbit coupling enables symmetry-selective interactions through which the ferromagnetic moment controls the altermagnetic domain manifold, with its out-of-plane and in-plane components biasing the time-reversal ($Z_2$) and orientational ($Z_3$) sectors, respectively. Our results reveal how two symmetry-distinct magnetic orders can retain separate ordering tendencies while remaining strongly coupled, providing a route towards internal control of altermagnetic domain states.
summary:
1. 作者结合磁化、弹热和输运测量，在Cr掺杂MnTe单晶中确立铁磁与交错磁序的均匀共存，并研究两序的高阶耦合。
2. 交错磁序先出现时使铁磁转变成为平滑交叉，后出现时则压低面外剩磁；面外、面内铁磁矩分别偏置Z₂时间反演畴与Z₃取向畴。
3. 2 K下场训练后约0.2%的零场电阻差支持非易失畴控制，但奈尔温度以上霍尔响应的涨落解释仍需直接测量交错磁序参量检验。

title: Triplon thermal Hall response in a honeycomb-lattice $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg antiferromagnet with Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interactions
abstract: We investigate triplon topology and the thermal Hall transport in a columnar valence-bond solid of a spin-$1/2$ honeycomb-lattice $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg antiferromagnet. Inequivalent triangular sublattices, modeled by $J_2^A\neq J_2^B$, remove inversion symmetry at nearest-neighbor bond centers and allow in-plane Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya (DM) interactions. We identify the two symmetry-allowed in-plane DM vector patterns and present detailed results for the pattern parallel to the bonds including an out-of-plane magnetic field. Within a harmonic bond-operator treatment, we determine the triplon bands, their Berry curvatures and Chern numbers, and the triplon thermal Hall conductivity. The DM interaction and magnetic field generate nonzero Berry curvatures, but the numerically integrated Chern number of every isolated triplon band vanishes. Nevertheless, the energy-dependent Bose weighting of positive and negative Berry-curvature regions produces a finite thermal Hall response at nonzero low temperatures. We delimit the dilute-triplon regime in which the harmonic transport calculation is expected to be reliable. These results show that a vanishing Chern number band does not directly constrain the triplon response of a valence-bond solid. We also comment on the effects on the columnar valence-bond solid phase of a DM interaction between next-nearest-neighbor spins characterized by an out-of-plane vector pattern.
summary:
1. 作者用键算符简谐近似，研究子晶格不等价的自旋1/2蜂窝J₁–J₂反铁磁柱状价键固体在沿最近邻键的DM作用和面外磁场下的三重态能带拓扑及热霍尔输运。
2. 三条孤立能带的陈数在数值精度内均为零，但能量依赖的玻色权重使正负贝里曲率贡献不再抵消，产生非零低温热霍尔响应。
3. 在所考察参数下，k_BT≳0.15J₁时三重态间相互作用可能重要，较高温输运仍需超越简谐近似检验。

title: Efficient Simulation of Gate Leakage Currents in Ultra-scaled Transistors from First Principles
abstract: To ensure high electrostatic integrity in ultra-scaled field-effect transistors (FETs), thin gate dielectric layers are typically needed, potentially giving rise to (strong) leakage currents. Being able to model this effect is therefore crucial. Here, we show how gate leakage currents can be computed at the ab initio level in WS$_2$-hBN FETs by extending the well-established quantum transmitting boundary method (QTBM). Two main challenges are tackled: (i) the calculation of the open boundary conditions (OBCs) for the gate contacts and (ii) the solution of the resulting sparse linear system of equations A x = b where the matrix A possesses an unstructured sparsity pattern. We demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state of the art and can be readily applied to simulate transistors with gate lengths exceeding 25 nm.
summary:
1. 针对超微缩晶体管的栅极漏电，作者以密度泛函模型结合栅边界布洛赫展开和自能低秩近似，扩展量子透射边界法模拟WS₂/hBN/Pt三端器件。
2. 该法在6.4纳米栅长下复现完整计算的透射谱，并实现25.6纳米栅长模拟；22.4纳米时求解较全秩方案提速7.8倍。
3. 该框架可用于比较不同介质的漏电，但推广时须验证有限栅的周期近似，现有结果限于外加势下的相干透射。

title: Spherical law for optimal layouts of random graphs
abstract: Can the nodes of a random graph be placed in an auxiliary space $\mathbb{R}^{M}$ so that its connectivity becomes local? The spring electric layout is a standard algorithm to try to find such local graph layouts; we study it as a statistical-physics problem by considering the Gibbs ensemble of spring-electric layouts. For graphs with independent edges we solve the model exactly at large number of nodes $N$ and fixed embedding dimension $M$. The node positions obey a spherical law: they are uniformly distributed in an $M$-dimensional ball; for $M=2$ this is closely related to Girko's circular law. Crucially, the ground state energy is flat across all layouts with that density: an optimal layout for one graph is asymptotically optimal for any other. Optimal layouts of i.i.d. graphs are therefore frustrated liquids, macroscopically constrained but microscopically unoptimizable. We discuss relations to graph-partitioning, Laplacian eigenmaps, and dimensionality reduction, and outline how this harsh result breaks down for correlated graphs.
summary:
1. 为检验随机图连接能否通过嵌入局域化，作者以吉布斯系综和复本法求解非负边权独立同分布、矩有限的稠密无向图的弹簧—静电布局。
2. 嵌入维数M≥2固定、节点数趋于无穷时，最优节点位置均匀分布于球内，跨图复用最优布局的每节点能量渐近不变，呈现微观不可优化的受挫液体。
3. 该结果为识别关联诱导的空间结构提供基线，但约千节点的数值结果仍显示有限尺寸效应，关联网络的可优化性尚待研究。

title: Exact Electron Dynamics in Linear and Chiral Cavities: Complete Field versus Single-Helicity Reduction
abstract: Can a chiral cavity turn a free electron into a Landau-like orbiting particle? We answer with exact solutions of three quadratic electron--cavity models in the dipole limit, valid at arbitrary coupling. A single linearly polarized mode dresses the electron mass, which delays its flight, slows the spreading of a wavepacket and entangles the packet with the cavity. The complete transverse field, with both circular helicities, keeps two commuting, gapless translations at any coupling, mode number and helicity splitting, so the electron stays ballistic and no synthetic magnetic field appears. Keeping a single helicity gives two inequivalent models that are not related by a gauge transformation: reducing before the Power--Zienau--Woolley transformation gives ballistic motion, whereas reducing after it gives a Landau-like crossed-quadrature Hamiltonian. They differ by a real uniform field $B=s\lambda^2/(2\omega_c)$ ($\omega_c$ the mode frequency, $\lambda$ the coupling, $s=\pm1$ the helicity). In the complete theory the frequency $\omega_{-s}$ of the partner helicity, measured against $g^2=\lambda^2/(2\omega_c)$, decides between them: the electron is ballistic for a stiff partner, and Landau-like only at the soft-partner point, through an exact canonical reorganization that holds for the active sector but not for observables such as the electron--photon entanglement. Projecting onto one helicity after the PZW transformation is therefore not by itself a mechanism for synthetic magnetism; the mode content of the cavity is.
summary:
1. 为判断手性腔能否使自由电子产生朗道型运动，作者在偶极近似下用辛传播子精确求解任意耦合的线偏振、完整双螺旋度及单螺旋度模型。
2. 完整场保留两个对易的无隙平移，因而不产生合成磁场；PZW变换前后截取单螺旋度分别给出弹道与朗道型模型，二者并非规范等价。
3. 调节伴随螺旋度频率可检验两类动力学，但完整理论中的朗道型对应仅限零频奇点的活性扇区，其在微观手性腔中的实现仍待验证。

title: Electron-electron interactions mediated by overdamped vibrations: Implications for chirality-induced spin selectivity
abstract: Motivated by chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS), we investigate spin polarization during molecular electron transfer through a correlated bridge in the presence of a rapidly relaxing Peierls mode. By modulating both electronic hopping and spin--orbit coupling, the mode mediates two-body spin-spin interactions, including isotropic, anisotropic, and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya exchange. We derive these interactions using an exact Lang-Firsov transformation for a four-site chiral bridge. We then include fast vibrational relaxation in the joint electron--vibration master equation and derive the reduced electronic dynamics to second order in the vibronic coupling, retaining both coherent and dissipative contributions and the finite-time buildup of the vibrational response. We test our derivation by numerical simulations, finding spin polarization accumulated at the acceptor after unpolarized injection, with nonmonotonic dependence on damping and bridge filling. Within the postulated local-loss model, our results show that rapid vibrational relaxation does not preclude spin polarization through a correlated bridge and provide a framework for assessing vibration-mediated interactions and dissipative dynamics as ingredients of CISS in molecular electron transfer.
summary:
1. 为检验快速振动弛豫是否阻碍电子转移中的自旋极化，作者在四格点关联手性桥中结合精确Lang–Firsov变换与二阶消元，保留相干、耗散及响应建立过程。
2. 跃迁与自旋轨道耦合的共同调制诱导反对称交换，基准数值模拟在非偏振注入后1皮秒得到−1.06%的受体极化，且极化可随阻尼变化反号。
3. 结果表明快速弛豫不必排除振动介导的自旋选择性，但结论依赖假设的局域损耗模型，仍需微观环境模型和具体分子参数检验。

title: Tunable Three-Body Interactions in Microwave-Shielded Polar Molecules
abstract: We show that microwave shielding, which enables collisionally stable ultracold polar molecules, also leads to genuine nonadditive three-body interactions comparable to the shielding interaction itself. Their magnitude, sign, and geometrical dependence can be flexibly controlled through microwave parameters and orientation. Interaction strengths can reach the ten kilohertz-scale for ultrapolar molecules in typical optical lattices. The nonadditive three-body interactions can stabilize novel many-body phases, and should be accounted for in quantum simulation with microwave shielded molecules.
summary:
1. 针对微波屏蔽分子的两体描述是否充分，作者以二阶微扰推导双微波缀饰下的非加和三体势，揭示其宇称混合起源。
2. 三体势的强度和符号可由微波与取向调节，在532纳米间距的KAg分子光晶格中可达十千赫量级，抵消最近邻两体势后可超过残余两体作用且保留碰撞屏蔽。
3. 分子量子模拟应纳入这些三体项，其构型依赖可能稳定非常规有序相，但具体新相仍待多体计算与实验检验。

title: Unifying dynamical electron-electron and electron-phonon interactions from first principles
abstract: Electron-phonon interactions in materials with free carriers are dynamically screened by low-energy electronic excitations, yet first-principles calculations almost always treat this screening in the adiabatic approximation. A fully dynamical treatment of metals and doped semiconductors within time-dependent density functional perturbation theory (TDDFPT) is expensive and numerically delicate. Here, we introduce DFPT+A downfolding ("A" for active space), which starts from the static density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) response of a computationally convenient base system and adds the dynamical screening of a low-energy active space, described by Wannier functions. The required statically screened electron-electron interaction is computed using DFPT directly in the basis of Wannier-function pairs and truncated in a computationally efficient and systematically improvable way. The method handles entangled bands and accurately reproduces TDDFPT at a fraction of its cost. We use it to compute the total dynamical electron-electron interaction, including direct Coulomb and phonon-mediated interactions with dynamically screened electron-electron and electron-phonon couplings, all on equal footing. In hole-doped monolayer hBN, the hybridization of the carrier plasmon with the longitudinal optical phonon makes the low-energy retarded interaction nonmonotonic in the carrier density, an effect missed by the adiabatic approximation. In metallic monolayer TaS2, nonadiabatic effects are weak and occur only due to the intraband electron-hole continuum and the nesting of nearly parallel Fermi velocities. We also validate the widely used screened-screened approximation for the phonon spectral function. This work opens the way to first-principles studies of spectral functions, transport, and superconductivity with dynamically screened interactions.
summary:
1. 为超越绝热屏蔽近似，作者提出DFPT+A下折叠法，在静态DFPT响应中加入Wannier低能活性空间的动态屏蔽，统一处理电子—电子与电子—声子相互作用。
2. 该法以较低成本再现TDDFPT结果，揭示空穴掺杂单层hBN中载流子等离激元与纵向光学声子杂化，使低能推迟相互作用随载流子密度非单调变化，而单层TaS₂的非绝热效应较弱。
3. 两种材料的对比提示非绝热效应依赖具体体系，该框架有望用于动态屏蔽下的谱函数、输运及超导研究。

title: Anisotropic Boltzmann transport in a tight-binding superlattice: Exact results for power-law energy-dependent scattering
abstract: We develop a complete Boltzmann transport theory for the in-plane ($\sigma_{xx}$) and out-of-plane ($\sigma_{zz}$) conductivities of an electronic superlattice consisting of a periodic stack of two-dimensional (2D) parabolic-band layers coupled along the superlattice axis by nearest-neighbor tunneling $t$, in the physically relevant regime $t\ll E_F$ where the Fermi surface is an open, corrugated cylinder. Within the relaxation-time approximation with a power-law energy-dependent scattering time $\tau(E)\propto E^{p}$, we study the seven models $p=0,\pm1,\pm3/2,\pm2$ as functions of the 2D electron density $n$ per layer and temperature $T$. For $p=-2$ (in plane) and $p\le -1$ (out of plane), long-lived carriers at the miniband bottom can dominate transport at finite temperature. For $p=-2$, these carriers produce a pronounced peak in $\sigma_{zz}(T)$ at $T\sim E_F$. We find that the temperature dependence of the anisotropic metallic dc conductivity can be highly counterintuitive depending on $t$, $T$, and $p$, with no generic increase or decrease with temperature. The Lorenz ratio is determined by the energy variance of the current-carrying electrons; the Wiedemann-Franz (WF) law is exact as $T\to0$ for all models at fixed $t$, with anisotropic corrections at finite temperature. Band-edge carriers first enhance the interlayer Lorenz ratio up to several times its low-temperature value through thermal occupation of separated energy ranges within the same electron band and then suppress it at high temperature by energy filtering. Strong violations of the Wiedemann-Franz law can therefore arise from miniband structure and energy-dependent elastic scattering alone.
summary:
1. 作者用弛豫时间近似研究弱隧穿耦合二维抛物带层超晶格的各向异性电热输运，将七种τ(E)∝E^p模型的输运系数精确约化为一维能量积分。
2. 当p=-2、t/E_F=0.01时，带底长寿命电子引发层间电导率峰，并在k_BT=0.1E_F使层间洛伦兹比达普适值的2.24倍，后者在高温又因能量过滤受抑。
3. 这些结果说明有限温度的维德曼–弗兰兹定律偏离不足以判定非费米液体，但预测受相干输运及带底寿命截止限制，且固定t时零温极限仍恢复该定律。

title: Frustration-Induced $1/6$-Vortex-Paired Phase in a Kagome XY Model
abstract: Geometric frustration can fractionalize vortices in two-dimensional XY systems, but a given frustrated model usually hosts only a single type of fractional vortex. Here we study a kagome XY model in which an antiferromagnetic coupling $J_1$ and a second-harmonic coupling $K$ favor two competing frustrated ground-state manifolds. For $K/J_1<1/9$, the ground states map onto those of the kagome three-state Potts antiferromagnet and support $1/3$ vortices; for $K/J_1>1/9$, they map onto those of the kagome Ising antiferromagnet and support $1/2$ vortices. At $K/J_1=1/9$, the two manifolds become degenerate, and bends in the domain walls between them carry $1/6$-vortex excitations. Tensor-network calculations show that a finite-temperature phase with quasi-long-range order only in $e^{6i\theta}$ emerges from this degenerate point, separating the $1/3$- and $1/2$-vortex-paired phases. This $1/6$-vortex-paired phase has no counterpart in either parent manifold, showing that competing frustrated manifolds provide a route to new fractional-vortex-paired phases.
summary:
1. 为检验挫折流形竞争能否产生新分数涡旋配对相，作者结合畴壁分析与张量网络计算，研究含反铁磁耦合J₁及二阶谐波K的笼目XY模型。
2. 在K/J₁=1/9附近发现有限温1/6涡旋配对相，隔开1/3与1/2配对相，其六阶谐波关联呈幂律而二、三阶短程，涡旋源于混合畴壁弯折。
3. 该机制为寻找其他分数涡旋配对相提供路径，约瑟夫森结阵列是候选平台，但实验实现及相变类型的衔接机制仍待研究。

title: ORCHID: Connecting Finite-Temperature Thermodynamic Evidence to Computational Materials Discovery
abstract: Finite-temperature phase stability is essential to materials discovery, but the evidence needed to describe it remains scattered across decades of literature. ORCHID organizes this evidence around the thermodynamic states that the observations describe, using tiered agentic extraction guided by thermodynamic rules, expert supervision and explicit validation. The collection contains 73,542 values from 1,321 papers, represented with their thermodynamic states, phase identities, provenance, evidence classes and uncertainty, together with assessed phase assemblages and calculated references. A qualified subset is released in ESPEI-compatible form for CALPHAD assessment, and machine-readable access supports both human and AI-assisted reuse. Blind expert evaluation of 48 diagram fields gives 93.8% agreement, increasing to 97.9% after accounting for notation conventions. On a common formation-enthalpy benchmark, eight MLIPs show residual spreads close to their DFT reference, motivating evaluation of finite-temperature phase stability through PhaseForge. One-shot MLIP-PhaseForge descriptions of Cu-Zr recover 0.35-0.56 of observed phase occurrences at assessed field points. ORCHID-assisted refinement through PhaseForge+ recovers 9 of 13 invariant temperatures within 2 sigma and reduces held-out activity error from 5.1 to 1.7 kJ/mol. By supplying interpreted literature evidence directly to gradient-based refinement through PhaseForge+, ORCHID connects evidence recovery to programmatic CALPHAD assessment. With the initial description and fitting datasets prepared, the final Cu-Zr refinement completes in approximately 27 minutes, providing a foundation for continuously updated thermodynamic models and their use in materials discovery.
summary:
1. 针对有限温度相稳定性证据分散，作者以热力学规则引导的分级智能体提取、专家监督与验证构建ORCHID，按热力学状态汇集1321篇文献的73542项数值。
2. 经ORCHID辅助的PhaseForge+梯度精修，Cu–Zr的13个不变反应温度中9个在2σ内复现，留出活度误差由5.1降至1.7 kJ/mol。
3. 该流程为文献证据驱动的CALPHAD评估和模型持续更新提供路径，但所示精修成效来自Cu–Zr，跨体系推广仍需验证。

title: Quantum-Geometric Subgap Second-Harmonic Generation in PT-Symmetric Antiferromagnetic Insulators
abstract: Although quantum geometry plays an established role in electronic transport and optical responses, the contribution of the time-reversal-odd Riemannian connection to fully subgap responses remains less explored. Here we identify intrinsic second-harmonic generation in PT-symmetric antiferromagnets, predominantly governed by the real sector of the interband Hermitian connection and arising entirely from virtual interband transitions. In bilayer MnBi$_2$Te$_4$, the response persists in trivial phases but is enhanced in the layer-Chern phase and reverses sign with Néel order, offering a probe of quantum geometry and phase-sensitive readout of antiferromagnetic order without mobile carriers or real excitations.
summary:
1. 作者用长度规范密度矩阵和双层MnBi₂Te₄八带模型，研究PT对称反铁磁绝缘体完全亚带隙倍频的量子几何机制。
2. 虚跃迁响应以带间厄米联络实部为主并含三带贡献，面外奈尔序下的面内倍频电导低频始于ω⁴、倾转允许ω²项，层陈相在相同直接带隙下仍增强。
3. 奈尔序反转使倍频振幅变号，提示可用不依赖移动载流子或实带间激发的相敏测量读出磁序，但仍需实验检验。

title: Faster-than-power-law decay of order parameter correlations in the two-dimensional RP$^2$ model: a rigorous result by vibe-proving
abstract: We consider the RP$^2$ model on the two-dimensional square lattice with nearest-neighbor interactions. It is obtained by replacing the spin in the standard classical Heisenberg model with a director, which does not distinguish two opposite directions. Unlike the standard classical Heisenberg model or the O(3) nonlinear sigma model, the RP$^2$ (and its cousin RP$^3$) model allows point vortex defects classified by $\pi_1(RP^2)= Z_2$ in two dimensions. It is tempting to expect the $Z_2$ vortices to induce a phase transition analogous to the well-established Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition in the O(2) model (XY model) in two dimensions. Indeed, the possibilities of a critical phase or a critical point with power-law correlations of the order parameter in the RP$^2$ and RP$^3$ models have been discussed in the literature. However, the challenging nature of the problem has prevented a definitive conclusion on the phase diagram so far. In this paper, we report a rigorous mathematical proof by Artificial Intelligence (ChatGPT 6 Astra) that the absolute value of the two-point correlation function of order parameters at distance $r$ in the RP$^2$ and RP$^3$ models on the two-dimensional square lattice is bounded above by $C_\beta \exp{(-c_\beta[\log(2+r)]^2)}$ for any finite inverse temperature $\beta\ge0$, with positive constants $C_\beta$ and $c_\beta$ depending only on $\beta$. Namely, the correlation function decays faster than any power of $r$. The proof is formalized and verified in Lean; the formalization is publicly available at doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23548847 . A heuristic argument based on a one-parameter effective theory ansatz at large distances combined with the rigorous correlation bound suggests (but does not prove) that the $Z_2$ vortices are always unbound at any nonzero temperature.
summary:
1. 为检验二维正方晶格RP²、RP³模型的幂律向列临界性，作者结合非对易旋转、薄环带傅里叶估计与群平均，建立经Lean核验的关联界。
2. 对有界正负耦合的自由边界体系及其局部极限，任意有限β≥0均有|C_Q(r)|≤Cβexp[−cβln²(2+r)]，排除四极关联的幂律临界性。
3. 指数衰减仅在高温β<ln(3/2)时获证，非零温度下涡旋始终解束缚仍是依赖有效理论假设的推测，其他类型相变尚未排除。

title: Coordination three heals, coordination four is hard: the antiferromagnetic Potts model with a costly third state
abstract: We study the ground states of the antiferromagnetic three-state Potts model in which the third state carries a single-ion energy cost $D_3$, on arbitrary lattices, and show that the difficulty of the ground-state problem is controlled by the maximum coordination $\Delta$ alone; on planar lattices with $\Delta\le5$ it is classified completely. On lattices with coordination at most three the third state heals frustrated bonds one for one: every graph of maximum degree three other than $K_4$ has an independent set of sites that meets every odd cycle and whose size equals the number $\operatorname{fr}$ of frustrated bonds of the Ising ground state. This identity also follows from known results on the chromatic vertex stability of graphs; we give a constructive proof. Hence $E_0 (D_3)=\min(D_3,1) \operatorname{fr}$ for all $D_3$, computable in polynomial time on planar lattices. In graph-theoretic terms, independent odd cycle transversal is solvable in polynomial time on planar subcubic graphs. On planar lattices with maximum coordination four, in contrast, deciding the ground-state energy is NP-complete for every fixed $0\le D_3<2$ and polynomial for $D_3\ge2$. The boundary is set by a local principle: a site of coordination $d$ in the third state relieves at most $\lfloor d/2\rfloor$ frustrated bonds, so the third state is useless once $D_3\ge\lfloor\Delta/2\rfloor$; this threshold is sharp for every $\Delta\ge3$ and reproduces the triangular-lattice point $D_3^*=3$ of the equivalent spin-1 Blume--Capel antiferromagnet. From a single Ising ground state the proof builds an exact ground state in polynomial time, which for quasicrystalline, foam-like and defective lattices with thousands of sites takes seconds to minutes.
summary:
1. 作者结合局域重着色、匹配与构造算法，研究反铁磁三态Potts模型中第三态代价D₃和最大配位Δ如何控制阻挫修复及基态求解难度。
2. 平面晶格Δ≤3时可多项式构造基态，第三态可逐键修复阻挫（K₄分量除外）；Δ=4时，能量判定在0≤D₃<2为NP完全，D₃≥2则多项式可解。
3. 该构造为准晶及缺陷网络提供可认证的零温基准，但平面图在Δ≥6、2≤D₃<⌊Δ/2⌋时的复杂性仍未确定。

title: Only the immortal can (almost) flock while turning: Two-dimensional chiral immortal flocks, time crystals and non-universal sub-logarithmic roughness
abstract: We study two-dimensional chiral ``dry'' (non-momentum conserving) ``immortal'' (number conserving) ``flocks'' (polar ordered active fluids). Noise driven fluctuations about the noise-free ``time crystal'' state, in which the velocity rotates uniformly in time, obey coupled Kardar-Parisi-Zhang-like equations for the local velocity orientation and a conserved concentration field; the latter field stabilizes order. Orientational fluctuations grow only sub-logarithmically, and number fluctuations are suppressed (``hyperuniform''); both exhibit nonuniversal scaling exponents. There are three different universality classes of disordering transitions.
summary:
1. 为厘清粒子数守恒能否稳定二维手性群集，作者对动量不守恒的活性流体建立相位—密度耦合类KPZ方程，并作单圈动力学重整化群分析。
2. 在无涡旋近似的稳定区内，取向相位方差按(ln L)^η增长，η>2/3且非普适，η<1时伴随超均匀数目涨落，但仍无真正长程取向序。
3. 理论还预言两类动力学失稳转变，而η=1处的涡旋解绑定及其双指数关联长度发散仅获启发式支持，仍待系统检验。

title: Airy distribution of the quenched spectral form factor in non-interacting fermions
abstract: For chaotic many-body systems as well as the random energy model, the logarithm of the (scaled) spectral form factor (SFF) exhibits two robust properties at late times: (i) self-averaging and (ii) a reflected-Gumbel distribution. Here, we demonstrate that both properties break down for $N$ non-interacting fermions on a lattice of size $L$ with an incommensurate single-particle spectrum. We show that the logarithm of the SFF, upon rescaling by $1/\sqrt{L}$, follows the Airy distribution, in stark contrast to the reflected-Gumbel law. Moreover, it is no longer self-averaging, as its mean and standard deviation are of the same order. While deviations from reflected-Gumbel statistics are generically expected for non-interacting systems, we find that an interacting integrable model exhibits reflected-Gumbel statistics at late times, mirroring the chaotic case and distinguishing it from non-interacting fermions.
summary:
1. 在无限温、固定密度的正则系综中，作者将单粒子能量有理无关的L格点自由费米子谱形因子对数的长时统计映射为零面积周期布朗路径极值，并用安德森链数值检验。
2. ln(SFF)/(2π√L)趋于无拟合参数的Airy分布，而未缩放对数的均值与标准差均随√L增长，因而不自平均。
3. 相互作用可积XXZ链的小尺寸数值呈反射Gumbel统计，提示该探针揭示自由谱的可加结构而非直接判别混沌，有限温下的分布仍待研究。

title: Multiband-Induced Complex Magnetotransport in the Kagome Metal LuNb$_6$Sn$_6$
abstract: We report the electrical transport properties of the kagome metal LuNb$_6$Sn$_6$, which undergoes a charge density wave (CDW) transition at $T_\mathrm{CDW}\approx80$ K. Similar to the kagome metals $A$V$_3$Sb$_5$ ($A$ = K, Rb, Cs), LuNb$_6$Sn$_6$ develops complex magnetotransport behavior near and below the CDW transition. In particular, the longitudinal magnetoconductivity exhibits an approximately linear field dependence below about 1 T, whereas the field dependence of Hall conductivity displays pronounced nonlinearity and a field-induced sign reversal. Although an anomalous Hall-like contribution can be extracted by subtracting a local background from the Hall conductivity, mobility-spectrum analysis shows that the overall magnetotransport can be largely accounted for by multiband conduction involving high-mobility electronlike and holelike carriers. Nevertheless, sizable deviations from the multiband model emerge near $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$, pointing to additional CDW-related scattering processes. These results demonstrate that high-mobility multiband transport, together with CDW-induced modifications of carrier scattering, play important roles in the complex magnetotransport of LuNb$_6$Sn$_6$.
summary:
1. 为辨析类反常霍尔响应的来源，作者对电荷密度波转变温度为79 K的笼目金属LuNb₆Sn₆单晶开展磁输运测量及迁移率谱分析。
2. 多带Drude模型大体同时重现低场纵向电导率近线性和霍尔电导率变号，部分电子通道的低温迁移率达10⁴ cm²/(V·s)量级。
3. 转变附近50—100 K的系统偏差无法靠增加常规Drude通道消除，可能涉及电荷序相关散射，而时间反演对称性破缺仍待独立探针检验。

title: Spin-conserving and spin-flip magnetic scattering in the altermagnetic spin-splitter effect
abstract: Critical magnetic fluctuations scatter electrons strongly near an ordering transition, but they barely degrade the charge current, because they scatter mostly through small angles. In an altermagnet the electric field also drives a spin current, and a nearly forward spin flip moves an electron to the other spin band at almost unchanged velocity. We develop a Boltzmann theory of the spin splitter ratio that keeps the full collision operator of quasistatic magnetic fluctuations and its change with the magnetic order. Fluctuations of equal total strength give the same resistivity for every fraction of spin flips, yet they can move the spin splitter ratio in opposite directions. Spin conserving fluctuations relax the spin current at about the charge relaxation rate, whereas forward flips equalize the two spin populations at equal energy at the quasiparticle rate, which in two dimensions grows linearly with the correlation length. Energy conservation on the split bands protects the part of the spin current carried by the band shift of the occupied states at every scattering strength, and the splitting blocks forward flips once the spin Fermi lines lie farther apart than the inverse correlation length. When flips dominate, a quarter to a half of the lattice band ratio survives. The transport time approximation reproduces the initial growth of the resistivity but recovers only a quarter to a half of the initial fall of the ratio, and a disorder series at fixed reduced temperature measures this fall independent of the order amplitude.
summary:
1. 为厘清临界磁涨落对交错磁体自旋分流的影响，作者在晶格及抛物能带上求解准静态玻尔兹曼方程，保留完整碰撞算符及其磁序依赖。
2. 相同电阻率可对应相反的分流比变化，二维前向翻转的弱散射抑制斜率随关联长度近线性增长，而输运时间近似在参考模型中仅再现初始降幅的23%—47%。
3. 固定约化温度的非磁性缺陷系列有望辨识翻转涨落，但须保持磁序和涨落谱不变并控制声子、界面效应，且有限劈裂会阻断前向翻转。

title: Spin conservation protects the altermagnetic spin-splitter current from critical scattering
abstract: Near a magnetic transition, critical fluctuations scatter electrons strongly, but the charge current survives, because long wavelength fluctuations barely turn the electron velocity. In an altermagnet the electric field also drives a spin current, the spin splitter effect, and a nearly forward scattering event that flips spin moves an electron to the other spin band at almost unchanged velocity. We show that the spin current shares the protection of the charge current only when the fluctuations conserve spin. Solving the Boltzmann equation with the full collision operator, including its change with the magnetic order, we find that forward flips equalize the two spin populations at equal energy at the quasiparticle rate, which in two dimensions grows linearly with the correlation length, whereas spin conserving fluctuations relax the spin current at a rate comparable to the charge relaxation rate. Fluctuations with the same resistivity can thus move the spin splitter ratio in opposite directions. Energy conservation protects the part of the spin current that follows the band shift of the occupied states, and the splitting blocks forward flips once the spin Fermi lines lie farther apart than the inverse correlation length. A disorder series at fixed reduced temperature measures the initial fall of the ratio with the magnetic resistivity independent of the order amplitude, and the growth of this slope toward the transition identifies spin flip critical fluctuations.
summary:
1. 为检验临界散射是否破坏交替磁体自旋分流，作者在二维准静态涨落模型中求解玻尔兹曼方程，保留碰撞算符的磁序依赖。
2. 自旋守恒时两种电流的弛豫率同阶，前向翻转则以随关联长度近线性增长的速率抹平等能自旋失衡；参考能带中输运时间近似仅再现分流比初始降幅的23%—47%。
3. 若无序不改磁序和涨落谱，固定约化温度的无序序列有望借分流比随磁电阻率的初始衰减斜率的临界增长识别翻转涨落，但能带劈裂会限制这一增强窗口。

title: An internal mode shifts the depinning threshold of dissociated dislocations without changing universality
abstract: Driven elastic manifolds exhibit a depinning transition whose large-scale behavior is governed by a nonequilibrium critical fixed point. Real interfaces, however, often possess internal degrees of freedom, raising the question of whether such modes alter depinning universality or only nonuniversal properties of the transition. We address this question for a dissociated dislocation, whose two Shockley partials define a fluctuating stacking-fault width driven by correlated random-alloy stresses. Comparing exact thresholds on identical disorder realizations with the width either free or frozen, we find that width fluctuations leave the depinning universality class unchanged: the roughness exponent $\zeta$ and correlation-length exponent $\nu$ remain the same even when the width becomes strongly fluctuating and locally multistable. The threshold, however, shifts. The shift is governed by the elastic crossover length of the internal mode rather than by multistability, and can have either sign. An infinite-range mean-field treatment misses this mechanism. With the physical two-partial elastic kernel and disorder calibrated against measured strengths, width fluctuations raise the athermal critical resolved shear stress by 10-35% over that of a rigid dissociated dislocation. An internal mode can thus be irrelevant at the depinning fixed point while remaining quantitatively important for where the transition occurs.
summary:
1. 为检验内模是否改变退钉普适性，作者用双弹性线模拟解离位错，在同一合金无序下比较层错宽度自由与冻结时的阈值及有限尺寸标度。
2. 粗糙度与关联长度指数在误差内一致，阈值却可升可降且主要受内模弹性交叉长度控制，物理弹性核模型预测零温临界分切应力较冻结宽度情形提高约10%—35%。
3. 这为补充刚性解离强化理论提供依据，但定量预测限于零温尺寸失配模型，尚需检验热激活和短程有序的影响。

title: Strong-Field-Driven Non-Linear Vibronic Coupling in an Asymmetric Donor-Acceptor Oligomer
abstract: Understanding how nuclear motion couples to intramolecular charge transfer beyond the perturbative regime of light--matter interaction remains an open problem. We tackle this problem by investigating the electron-nuclear response of an acceptor-donor-acceptor oligomer with structural asymmetry due to the partial fluorination of an acceptor unit. Adopting real-time time-dependent density functional theory combined with Ehrenfest dynamics, we excite the systems with a resonant pulse of varying intensity, spanning the weak-, intermediate-, and strong-coupling regimes. When nuclei are clamped, field-driven charge preferentially flows from the donor to the fluorinated acceptor, with selectivity reduced upon increasing intensity. With moving ions, the early-time spatial response remains qualitatively unchanged, despite a distinct, spatially asymmetric charge redistribution. In the strong-field regime, nuclear motion preserves the preference for field-driven charge accumulation on the fluorinated acceptor, although the process takes approximately twice the time as in the fixed-nuclei scenario. Mode-resolved kinetic-energy analysis reveals that, with increasing field strength, the laser-induced nuclear response shifts from selected bond stretchings to collective low-frequency modes. These results provide a benchmark for assessing the interplay between vibronic dynamics and strong-field coupling in donor/acceptor oligomers.
summary:
1. 为探查强场电荷转移中的振电反馈，作者用实时含时密度泛函结合Ehrenfest动力学，对比单端氟化非对称受体—给体—受体低聚物的固定核与动核响应。
2. 5 TW/cm²下，核运动使氟化受体时均电子积累达固定核的约1.9倍，随场增强主导振动由高频骨架伸缩转向500–700 cm⁻¹含硫环形变。
3. 低频结构重组可能用于调控强场电荷分离，但局域泛函与平均场核动力学仅支持定性结论，退相干及核分支的影响仍待检验。

title: Integer defects in active nematics of ellipsoidal Quincke rollers
abstract: Transverse propulsion changes topological ordering in dense ellipsoidal Quincke rollers. Under an alternating-current electric field, a polar velocity field coexists with perpendicular nematic particle alignment. The system supports integer +1 velocity vortices with radial particle axes and -1 saddle defects. Oppositely charged defects migrate along domain walls and annihilate as polar domains merge. These results identify propulsion direction relative to particle shape as a control parameter for defect textures and collective ordering.
summary:
1. 为研究横向推进如何改变缺陷拓扑，作者在130 Hz交流电场驱动的稠密椭球形Quincke滚子中分析粒子取向、速度及极化场梯度。
2. 极性速度场与向列取向正交，自发形成长轴径向排列的+1速度涡旋和−1四重对称鞍点，异号缺陷沿畴壁湮灭，伴随全局极性序增强。
3. 结果为通过推进方向与粒子形状的相对关系设计缺陷纹理提供依据，但其他推进角度下的拓扑选择仍待检验。

title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. I. Clean surface properties
abstract: Ab initio calculations were used to elucidate the properties of the polar surfaces of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors, i.e., metal- and nonmetal-terminated. The systems considered were clean wurtzite gallium nitride (i.e. (0001) and (000-1) GaN surfaces), zinc blende gallium phosphide (i.e. (111) and (-1-1-1) GaP), gallium arsenide (i.e. (111) and (-1-1-1) GaAs), and (111) and (-1-1-1) GaSb surfaces. The calculated data include the crystallographic structure and the electronic states of the termination atoms on both sides, i.e. their positions, energies, and occupations. All nonmetal-terminated surfaces exhibit no reconstruction, and their broken-bond states are located in the vicinity of the valence band maxima (VBM), pinning the Fermi level. The Ga-terminated surface exhibited (4 x 4) reconstruction related to the division of termination atoms into sp3 and sp2 hybridized in proportions of 6 to 10, based on charge redistribution according to the electron counting rule (ECR). Thus, the broken-bond state is separated into two sets, occupied and empty, with the Fermi level located between them in the vicinity of the conduction band minimum (CBM).
summary:
1. 作者用第一性原理计算研究GaN、GaP、GaAs和GaSb洁净极性面的结构与电子态，比较Ga与非金属终止的影响。
2. 非金属终止面无重构，悬挂键态在价带顶附近钉扎费米能级；Ga终止面形成4×4重构，sp³与sp²杂化原子比为6∶10，符合电子计数规则，费米能级位于占据与空悬挂键态之间、靠近导带底。
3. 这些结果可为极性面生长建模提供洁净表面基准，但尚不能据此确定实际生长机制。

title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. II. Adsorption of nonmetal atoms (N, P, As, and Sb) on Ga-terminated surfaces
abstract: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate the adsorption processes on Ga-terminated surfaces of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. The considered adsorbates are nonmetal species, i.e., nitrogen, phosphorus, arsenic, and antimony on wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e., GaN(0001) surfaces, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e., GaP(111), gallium arsenide, GaAs(111), and gallium antimonide, GaSb (111) surfaces. The cases investigated include single adsorbed nonmetal atoms and full coverage, i.e. theta=1 of these surfaces. The calculated results include the stable sites and the energies of the single adsorbed atoms: located at H3 sites at low coverage and in on-top positions at high coverage for GaP, GaAs and GaSb. At high nitrogen coverage, the N2 admolecules are formed, weakly attached to the surface. The calculated electronic properties of the single-adatom systems include the band diagrams of the slabs in real and momentum space, the energies of the quantum states. In addition, the overlaps of the quantum states of the nonmetal adatoms and the nearest topmost surface Ga atoms are given. The full coverage data include the atomic configurations and the bond energies of the adsorbed layers. The electronic properties include the above-mentioned data for single adatoms, together with additional properties related to interactions between adsorbed atoms. The evaporation stability analysis confirms that the adatoms stabilize the topmost Ga atoms against detachment because of the high energy barrier of DE > 3 eV which is further increased to DE > 4 eV by coverage located at H3 sites. Thus, growth simulations should employ unreconstructed Ga-terminated surfaces covered by nonmetal atoms located at on-top positions.
summary:
1. 作者用从头算研究GaN、GaP、GaAs和GaSb的Ga终止极性表面，比较非金属单原子及满覆盖层的吸附构型与表面稳定性。
2. P、As、Sb低覆盖占H3位、满覆盖占顶位，高氮覆盖形成弱吸附N₂；吸附使表层Ga脱离势垒超过3 eV，H3位覆盖时超过4 eV。
3. 作者据此建议生长模拟采用非金属顶位覆盖的未重构Ga终止表面，其对实际生长过程的适用性仍待验证。

title: Mirror-symmetry engineering of altermagnetism based on monolayer hexagonal lattices
abstract: Altermagnetism (AM) is a novel collinear antiferromagnetic phase characterized by spin-polarized bands and zero net magnetization. However, realizing AM in monolayer hexagonal lattices is strongly constrained by lattice symmetry. Here, we propose a mirror-symmetry-based design principle and implementation scheme for realizing AM based on monolayer hexagonal lattices and validate it using holey graphyne (HGY) as a representative system. By examining hydrogenated nonmetal units X$-$H (X = B, C, N, P, and S) introduced along the mirror-symmetry axis and extending the analysis to N$-$F, we identify the configurations that form two antiparallel spin sublattices related by mirror reflection. The N$-$H structure forms a stable altermagnetic ground state, with a momentum-dependent spin splitting up to 148.2 meV. The magnetism originates from $\pi-\pi$ superexchange interactions, and H/F functionalization stabilizes intrinsic AM by regulating the local charge distribution. Our work offers insights into the design of light-element altermagnetic materials.
summary:
1. 针对六角单层交替磁性的对称性限制，作者以第一性原理计算研究多孔石墨炔的非金属氢化修饰，构造镜面而非反演关联的反平行自旋子晶格。
2. N–H修饰经电荷调控与π–π超交换稳定零净磁矩的交替磁基态，非相对论d波自旋劈裂最大达148.2 meV。
3. 该策略为轻元素交替磁体提供设计路径，但N–H体系的奈尔温度仅由模型估算为约29 K，材料制备与磁有序仍待实验验证。

title: Finite-time Mpemba crossings with imperfect preparation
abstract: Two preparations evolving under the same thermal Markov generator can reverse their ordering in relative entropy even when the hotter state retains a nonzero slow-mode component. We derive a sufficient finite-time crossing condition for arbitrary finite irreducible reversible systems. The condition compares the preparations' weights in the entire slowest eigenspace, including degeneracies, and gives an explicit upper bound using the separation from the next distinct decay rate. Exact finite-amplitude entropy comparisons also yield all-mode enclosures and bounds based on a retained spectrum with a controlled omitted tail. A preparation-error inequality converts finite-time sign margins into explicit probability tolerances; extensions account for temperature, generator, and stationary-reference uncertainty. We test the bounds on 2000 predefined network draws with four graph families and 4--64 states. There are 86 numerically located crossings, of which 45 satisfy the simple sufficient condition. In a selected eight-state example, retaining two nonstationary modes certifies a crossing before 1.55163, improving a certified slow-sector endpoint of 2.53951; the located crossing is near 1.26943. A reflecting diffusion in an asymmetric potential supplies a separate physical example, with systematic mesh refinement. Independent interval arithmetic certifies selected spectral bounds, finite-grid first crossings, and an entire preparation-temperature rectangle in a three-state benchmark. The theorem does not require exact slow-mode cancellation, while its numerical sharpness and detection coverage remain model dependent. These results concern relative-entropy relaxation and do not predict water-freezing times.
summary:
1. 为判断不完美制备下的相对熵弛豫能否反序，作者在有限不可约可逆马尔可夫链中结合谱分解与精确熵包络，推导交叉时间界及制备误差容限。
2. 充分判据允许热态最慢模非零，保留两个衰减模并控制谱尾将八态算例的认证交叉上界从2.53951收紧至1.55163。
3. 这些界可量化异常弛豫对制备精度的要求，但判据松紧依模型而变，连续扩散极限仍需独立误差认证。

title: Underdamped Stochastic Optimal Transport with Landauer boundary conditions: machine learning and analytical solution
abstract: Finding optimal transport protocols for underdamped stochastic processes is a difficult yet important problem in control theory. In this paper we develop a direct method, based on machine learning, to find the optimal solution of the problem in the presence of non-linear boundary conditions, including those modelling the Landauer bit-erasure problem. The dynamics is steered from a single-peak to a double-peak distribution in position space, by only acting on a controllable external potential. The problem is highly non-linear, and analytical solutions are not available in general. We benchmark our numerical results with a perturbative expansion, which is expected to hold in a suitable overdamped limit.
summary:
1. 作者在一维欠阻尼朗之万模型中，用神经网络和Girsanov重加权优化仅靠位置势的分布输运，最小化路径相对熵及终态相对熵罚项，无需对轨迹求导。
2. 高斯算例复现矩方程基准，非高斯单峰至双峰算例在ε=0.2、罚项权重M=200时的终态位置分布接近目标，并与二阶多尺度近似基本相符。
3. 向高维及平均熵产生优化的推广尚待验证，现有非线性控制力的数值与解析预测仍有差异，近过阻尼展开也缺少严格误差界。

title: Hierarchy of Electromagnetic Gauge Field Quantum Geometries
abstract: The conventional Bloch quantum geometric tensor (QGT) describes electric-dipole geometry for spatially uniform perturbations and vertical Bloch transitions. We develop a broader framework linking quantum geometry to local and nonlocal electromagnetic response in gauge-field space, placing this tensor within a hierarchy of electric and magnetic multipole quantum geometries. The intrinsic antisymmetric adiabatic response in every electromagnetic channel is a Berry curvature in the space of its conjugate fields. The field-dependent projector uniquely fixes the QGT for that channel, pairing the response curvature with a quantum metric. This construction extends to spatially nonuniform perturbations, whose finite momentum transfer induces nonvertical Bloch transitions. We explicitly construct the current--current QGT connecting Bloch states at $\mathbf{k}\pm\mathbf{q}/2$, providing a unified metric and curvature description of nonlocal current response. In the doubled Brillouin zone, tangential derivatives generate conventional momentum-space QGT multipoles, whereas normal derivatives connect finite-momentum geometry to uniform electric- and magnetic-multipole-pair QGTs. We derive this connection through second order in $\mathbf{q}$. The finite-momentum curvature governs the intrinsic nonlocal Hall response, while an inverse-frequency moment of symmetric optical absorption probes the index-symmetric metric sector.
summary:
1. 为统一局域与非局域电磁响应的几何描述，作者以场依赖投影算符构建多极对量子几何层级及有限动量电流—电流张量。
2. 其动量转移展开至二阶的系数由均匀多极对几何组合构成，时间反演对称、反演破缺绝缘体模型数值检验了长波度规展开。
3. 实验有望通过本征非局域霍尔电导和对称光吸收逆频矩分别提取曲率与度规，但后者仅约束指标对称部分，有限频窗只给出部分权重。

title: Static and dynamic density correlations of interacting active Brownian particles
abstract: We develop a stochastic Dean--Kawasaki field theory to predict the static structure factor and collective intermediate scattering function of interacting active Brownian particles. Starting from the microscopic overdamped dynamics, we derive coupled stochastic equations for the density and polarization fields using an angular-moment closure. Gaussian linearization then yields closed analytical expressions for static and dynamic density correlations in terms of propulsion speed, mean number density, interaction potential, translational and rotational diffusivities. The coupling between density and polarization predicts a crossover from exponential relaxation to damped oscillations despite the absence of inertia. For Gaussian-core potential, the predictions contain no fitting parameters. Brownian dynamics simulations show quantitative agreement at low activity and long wavelengths, and reproduce the crossover behaviour. For Weeks--Chandler--Andersen potential, the nonintegrable core makes both the Fourier transform of the potential and the self-interaction correction term in the Dean--Kawasaki field theory ill-defined. We therefore introduce an approximation that replaces the interaction potential with a passive direct-correlation function fitted separately at each density and temperature. This approximation requires no additional activity-dependent fitting parameters.
summary:
1. 为预测二维相互作用活性布朗粒子的密度关联，作者从过阻尼动力学出发，以Dean–Kawasaki场论、角矩闭合与高斯线性化求得静态结构因子和集体中间散射函数。
2. 密度—极化耦合给出依赖波矢及相互作用的无惯性阻尼振荡阈值，高斯核势预测在低活性、长波长下无需拟合即与模拟定量吻合。
3. WCA势需逐状态拟合被动直接关联函数的四个系数，无额外活性拟合但仅定性再现转变；现有高斯近似尚不描述运动诱导相分离，非线性及高阶角矩修正有待检验。

title: Pair density waves via interband pairing --- a perspective from superfluid weight
abstract: Pair density waves (PDW) are superconducting states that exhibit a spatially modulated pairing order parameter, corresponding to Cooper pairs carrying finite center-of-mass momentum. While some recent studies have emphasized the role of quantum geometry in stabilizing PDW order in certain multiband systems, we here present a systematic investigation of an alternative, geometry-independent mechanism: PDW order driven purely by interband Cooper pairing. Using the superfluid weight (SW) as a diagnostic, we study two canonical models. The first is the classic Fulde-Ferrell model of an $s$-wave superconductor subject to a Zeeman splitting field, which realizes pure interband pairing between two rigidly shifted bands; the second is a spinless honeycomb-lattice model with nearest-neighbor $f$-wave pairing, a modified version of which was recently found to exhibit PDW instability in density-matrix renormalization-group simulations. In both models the SW receives no quantum geometric contribution at the mean-field level, yet it can be greatly suppressed or even turn negative, signaling a tendency toward pairing with spatial phase modulations. For the first model, we establish that the SW is increasingly suppressed as the Zeeman field grows, drastically turning negative upon the emergence of extensive gapless excitations, i.e., the Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces. For the honeycomb $f$-wave model, we demonstrate, both analytically and numerically, vanishing quantum-geometric SW and an invariably negative total SW. Our results thus establish the SW as a qualitative indicator of the tendency toward PDW order, and provide a microscopic rationale for the interband-pairing-driven PDW instability.
summary:
1. 为检验纯带间配对能否不依赖量子几何诱发配对密度波，作者用线性响应与自洽平均场计算塞曼分裂s波及无自旋蜂窝最近邻f波模型的超流权重。
2. 两模型的几何贡献均为零，两带反向色散使蜂窝模型零温权重为负，而塞曼模型在玻戈留波夫费米面出现时权重骤降。
3. 负权重可诊断均匀配对失稳，但正权重不排除配对密度波，量子涨落与竞争序的影响仍需超越平均场检验。

title: Spontaneous Circular Dichroism and Memory Effect from Surface Defects in Altermagnetic MnTe
abstract: Altermagnetism has emerged as a new class of magnetism with vanishing magnetization and macroscopic time reversal symmetry breaking. Hexagonal MnTe is a g-wave altermagnet with a 307 K Néel temperature, large spin splitting, and an anomalous Hall effect. However, the relationship between altermagnetism and the anomalous Hall effect in MnTe remains debated. Here, using optical magnetic circular dichroism, we observe hysteresis and a memory effect in a MnTe bulk crystal below 250 K. No hysteresis is seen after polishing the bulk crystal and in thin films. We conclude that the hysteresis in magnetic circular dichroism in the bulk crystal is from surface defects. The similar temperature dependence and a sign change between circular dichroism and the anomalous Hall effect indicate that the origin of the anomalous Hall effect in transport is likely not intrinsic.
summary:
1. 为检验MnTe自发磁光响应是否源于体相交错磁序，作者用633纳米磁圆二色性测量比较单晶抛光前后及外延薄膜。
2. 未抛光单晶在约250 K以下出现磁滞、约200 K反号，回线偏移方向受冷却场控制，而抛光后及具有异常霍尔效应的薄膜均未见磁滞。
3. 结果支持缺陷相关的表面贡献，但尚不能确认异常霍尔效应具有相同的非本征起源，缺陷性质与记忆机制仍待澄清。

title: Fano Resonance of a Magnonic Ring Resonator with a Nano-Scatterer Embedded in a Magnonic Conduit
abstract: We present micromagnetic simulation of a nanoscale magnonic ring resonator coupled to a magnonic waveguide, with and without a hole embedded in the waveguide (H-NRR and NRR respectively), for realizing transformation into a Fano resonance frequency spectral lineshape from a Lorentzian one. Transmission and reflection spectra of the H-NRR and NRR have been analyzed for different structural parameters (embedded hole diameter and gap between the ring and the waveguide) and material parameters (damping factor of the ring) to achieve maximum spectral transmission magnitude variation. The obtained micromagnetic simulation results are supported by an analytical model that consists of two-tracks of wave propagation, forwards and backwards. Our findings show that H-NRR system demonstrates a monotonic dependence of spectral transmission magnitude variation against the aforementioned design parameters (gap and damping) which should provide better engineering controllability and tolerance when compared with the original NRR system. Overall, our proposed structure and study may help in building unconventional magnonic integrated circuits for sensing, data processing systems and computing.
summary:
1. 作者结合微磁模拟与包含双向传播及环内简并模的线性解析模型，研究钇铁石榴石环—波导中纳米孔对自旋波共振线形的调控。
2. 40纳米孔使约2.62和2.91吉赫共振由洛伦兹型转为法诺型，透射振幅峰谷差在扫描范围内随间隙或环阻尼增大而单调减小，区别于无孔结构的先增后减。
3. 单调响应有望简化参数寻优，但尚待实验验证，孔移出耦合区后恢复洛伦兹线形的行为及增强的反射也需纳入集成设计。

title: Existence of the thermodynamic limit for the Hopfield model
abstract: We prove that the quenched pressure of the Hopfield model with $K\sim\alpha N$ i.i.d. symmetric Rademacher patterns has a thermodynamic limit at every load $\alpha\in(0,\infty)$, finite inverse temperature and uniform external field, with no replica-symmetry, order-parameter concentration or non-condensation hypothesis required. The limit is the supremum over $r$ of limiting pressures of mixed models with $r$ binary patterns in a Gaussian bulk. Via the Hubbard--Stratonovich representation we extract the finitely many patterns whose hidden coordinates exceed $\delta\sqrt N$; a collective interpolation replaces the other binary patterns by Gaussian ones with error $O(\delta^2)$ uniform in the volume, and convex concentration on the discrete cube controls the disorder-dependent choice of retained patterns. For the mixed models we prove a Gaussian hidden-spin truncation bound uniform in the volume and in an arbitrary Ising potential, and convergence for Gaussian bulks with finitely many site-field types, reducing to results of Ho and of Chen, Ho and Issa on non-convex vector spin glasses with compact spins. For Gaussian patterns we give an alternative proof of the existence result announced by Camilli, Contucci and Mingione, extended to a uniform field and an extra binary pattern. In both cases the pressure has exponentially small deviation probabilities and converges a.s.; internal energy and entropy converge wherever the limit is differentiable. An extra binary Mattis pattern admits a scalar variational reduction. At zero field the Rademacher pressure dominates the Gaussian one with an extra binary pattern, which dominates the pure Gaussian one. No explicit formula is given. The proofs were generated through extensive interaction with the AI models Claude (Opus~5.5) and ChatGPT (Sol~6.1), based on the problem formulation and guidance of the authors.
summary:
1. 针对存储独立对称二元模式且模式数随神经元数线性增长的Hopfield模型，作者以隐自旋表象、有限模式提取和集体高斯替换研究淬火压强的热力学极限。
2. 证明极限在任意正存储负载、有限逆温及均匀场下存在，无需副本对称或非凝聚假设，且等于保留有限二元模式的高斯背景模型极限压强的上确界。
3. 由此还得到基态能量密度收敛，但极限压强的显式公式与相图尚未确定，单个保留模式是否足够仍是开放问题。

title: Thermal conductivity of Lennard-Jones fluids from equilibrium thermodynamics
abstract: We derive a general expression for the thermal conductivity of simple fluids within a thermodynamic transport theory (TTT) in which the Onsager coefficients of an interacting system are related to those of an ideal reference system through the ratio of the determinants of the Hessians of the relevant thermodynamic potential. The transported quantity is identified with an effective energy density proportional to the rms energy fluctuations of a small fluid cell. The result expresses the thermal conductivity as the product of its dilute-gas value and a function of equilibrium thermodynamic properties, namely the specific heats at constant density and at constant $\rho T$ and the temperature derivative of the latter, with no adjustable parameters. For hard spheres, it reduces to a previously verified expression in terms of the thermodynamic factor. The theory is tested against molecular dynamics results for the Lennard-Jones (LJ) and the truncated and shifted Lennard-Jones (LJTS) fluids in the supercritical region, for densities up to $\rho^*=0.8$, using equations of state based on perturbation theory. For the LJTS fluid, the mean absolute percentage error is below 8\% for all the temperatures considered. For the LJ fluid, the predictions are compared with those of the revised Enskog theory for Mie fluids, using the same equation of state: TTT gives smaller errors at almost all temperatures, with a significant improvement at low temperatures, where the errors are reduced approximately by a factor between two and three.
summary:
1. 为从平衡性质预测热导率，作者以局域能量均方根涨落构造有效输运变量，通过热力学势海森行列式比导出无调参公式，并用超临界LJ及截断平移LJ流体的分子动力学检验。
2. 热导率由稀薄气体值乘以热容及其导数构成的因子给出，LJTS各测试等温线平均绝对百分比误差低于8%，同一状态方程下低温LJ误差约为修正Enskog理论的1/2至1/3。
3. 该方法无需结构输入，但精度依赖状态方程三阶导数，尚未描述临界热导率增强，推广至临界区需纳入长程涨落。

title: Shock Loading Accesses Reaction Pathways beyond Accelerated Thermolysis
abstract: Thermolysis and shock loading can produce similar major stable products in energetic materials, despite different chemical evolution and reaction pathways. Here, we develop EMFF-MACE, a reactive machine-learning potential for C/H/N/O energetic materials, enabling thermolysis simulations of 20 materials and shock simulations of 10 on a common potential energy surface. Comparisons at matched normalized reaction progress reveal divergent chemical states and local structural environments. Mean reaction-state similarity decreases from 94.0% at 20% progress to 25.9% at trajectory endpoints, while 47.1-92.6% of shock local environments lie outside corresponding material-specific thermolysis reference domains. Structural and reaction-network analyses reveal enhanced intermolecular reorganization and additional association and rearrangement branches under shock loading, despite partially shared early decomposition chemistry. These findings show that loading history influences the structural states and subsequent reaction pathways accessed during decomposition, rather than merely the rate of thermolysis.
summary:
1. 为检验冲击是否仅加速热解，作者构建EMFF-MACE机器学习势，在同一势能面模拟20种含能材料热解及其中10种的冲击反应，并按归一化反应进度对齐轨迹。
2. 冲击下平均80.8%的局域环境超出对应热解采样域，PETN与TKX-50的净反应网络出现额外的组分间缔合与重排支路。
3. 这些结果支持在反应模型中考虑加载历史，但温压及绝对转化率未匹配，压缩、升温与变形速率的独立贡献仍待厘清。

title: Microswimmers lose by swimming selfishly
abstract: At low Reynolds number, microswimmers are coupled by the flows they create, even when they are apart. The best way for each swimmer to push itself forward then depends on its neighbors, turning swimming together into a game. To study this, we optimize the shape changes of soft swimmers, alone and in pairs, with a differentiable Stokes solver. From random initial membrane motions, a lone swimmer converges to a traveling membrane wave. In a pair, the stroke of a swimmer affects its neighbor far more than the neighbor affects its own best stroke. For swimmers in line, this influence decays as $1/\ell$ with their separation $\ell$, whereas the incentive to respond decays as $1/\ell^2$. Selfish swimmers, which maximize their own payoff, respond only to the weak incentive. The cooperative gain they miss decays only as $1/\ell^2$, and their selfish adaptations leave the pair worse off than if both had kept their solitary strokes. Related swimmers, which also value the payoff of their neighbor, recover this gain, whereas competitors pay to hinder each other, both following a law that we derive analytically. Hydrodynamics alone thus makes swimming in company a social dilemma, whose outcome depends on how much the swimmers value each other.
summary:
1. 作者用可微二维斯托克斯求解器优化单个及成对软膜微泳者的周期形变，考察流体耦合下个体与集体最优的冲突。

title: Tensor cluster expansion as an efficient surrogate for multi-ACE
abstract: In this work, we generalize an on-lattice tensor cluster expansion (TCE) framework to an arbitrary correlation order. We show that these generalized tensor cluster expansion features span a subspace of MACE features, suggesting that TCE features can sufficiently pre-screen MACE features for chemical diversity in alloyed transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers. We show that, using maximum-entropy subset sampling, we can empirically recover chemical diversity from MACE features using a cheaper TCE representation. We then fine-tune a multi-ACE (MACE) potential with both subsets, and use this potential to predict temperature-dependent vibrational properties in alloyed TMD monolayers with varying chemical ordering. In our approach, TCE features can be used as cheap surrogate features for pre-screening chemically rich configurations using MACE features, allowing for the more efficient finetuning of atomic cluster expansion (ACE) potentials, thus achieving a tractable prediction of finite-temperature alloy thermodynamics on modest hardware.
summary:
1. 为低成本筛选合金化学多样性，作者将晶格张量团簇展开（TCE）推广至任意关联阶，并在过渡金属二硫族化物单层上用最大熵选样微调MACE势。
2. 固定晶格下，角阶和通道充足的MACE不变特征可表示TCE特征；TCE单CPU特征提取较MACE快约17倍，两种选样所得势在100—400 K的振动态密度近乎一致。
3. 该策略有望降低合金热力学采样成本，但TCE对离晶格缺陷与方向性自由度的描述仍待扩展。

title: Solvable coupled cluster states in $d=\infty$ with prescribed momentum distribution
abstract: Two of the most successful ideas in many-body theory, the exponential coupled cluster ansatz and DMFT, have to date developed separately. We establish a connection between them, by showing that the infinite dimensional limit of the hypercubic lattice allows the exact closed-form evaluation of static expectation values of coupled cluster wave functions, provided the cluster amplitudes admit a low-rank decomposition. As a result, evaluation errors -- a serious concern in conventional coupled cluster theory -- can be disentangled from limitations to expressivity of coupled cluster states. For this family of coupled cluster states, the cavity construction in $d\to\infty$ exactly reduces the environment of a lattice site to a Gaussian Grassmann kernel, and irreducible diagrams for one-body expectation values are found to be site-diagonal (in analogy to the DMFT self-energy). The resulting ``impurity problem" is an integral over a finite number of Grassmann variables rather than a dynamical quantum impurity problem, so that static observables derive exactly from a static self-consistency condition: a wave function counterpart of DMFT. For the simplest case of a cluster amplitude restricted to rank-one doubles, we obtain the momentum distribution in closed form. We show that any momentum distribution can be realized by a state that is the exact and unique ground state of an explicit parent Hamiltonian with a gapless single-particle tunnelling spectrum. By construction these coupled cluster states variationally recover low order perturbation theory for the Hubbard model. Their failure in the strong coupling regime near the Mott transition diagnoses a fundamental limitation of coupled cluster doubles. Intriguingly, our family of coupled cluster wave functions includes a gapless state with zero quasiparticle weight, with a momentum distribution that is completely smooth at the Fermi energy.
summary:
1. 为调控动量分布并精确计算局域关联，作者在无限维超立方晶格上用空腔法，将一类低秩耦合簇态的求值化为有限Grassmann变量的静态自洽问题。
2. 秩一双激发可实现任意粒子—空穴对称的能量依赖动量分布，显式母哈密顿量的构造还证明，费米能处光滑的分布可与无隙单粒子隧穿谱共存。

title: Relaxation speed in quenched-random force fields
abstract: Disorder is commonly expected to slow down relaxation, as in glasses and disordered magnets. Here we show that this need not be the case in general, by analysing the asymptotic relaxation rate of a Brownian particle in a harmonic background potential and a quenched-random Gaussian force field with conservative and non-conservative components. Combining weak-disorder perturbation theory, random-matrix theory, and numerical solutions of the Fokker-Planck equation, we show that the outcome depends on the geometry of the background and on the properties of the random forces. We identify two distinct mechanisms that shape the relaxation speed: an effective stiffening of the background by the disorder, as previously reported in one dimension, and interactions (repulsive and attractive) between the levels of the Fokker-Planck operator. Through level attraction, a common feature of non-Hermitian operators, non-conservative driving forces pull the slowest mode towards faster ones, which facilitates faster relaxation. In anisotropic backgrounds, both effects occur at second order in the disorder strength, enabling either slower or faster relaxation. In isotropic backgrounds, level interactions dominate and the disorder affects the degenerate slowest mode already at first order. The shift is then given by the left-most eigenvalue of a Gaussian random matrix and relaxation is generically slowed down. In backgrounds whose anisotropy is comparable to the disorder strength, level attraction is most effective by merging the slowest mode with its neighbour into an oscillating complex-conjugate pair. In this case, relaxation becomes faster on average once the random forces are sufficiently non-conservative. Our results draw a nuanced picture of how disorder affects the asymptotic relaxation speed in complex systems and uncover general mechanisms that are likely to apply beyond the current setting.
summary:
1. 作者结合弱无序微扰、随机矩阵理论和福克–普朗克方程数值解，研究谐势中淬火高斯随机力是否必然减慢布朗粒子的渐近弛豫。
