title: Anomalies of TQFTs coupled to parameter spaces and constraints on ground-state degeneracies
abstract: Anomalies of global symmetries can arise in long-range entangled quantum many-body systems and provide useful constraints on their dynamics. In this paper, we study anomalies of $d$-dimensional topological quantum field theories (TQFTs) coupled to parameter spaces and their implications for ground-state degeneracies. Specifically, we formulate anomalies as obstructions to constructing parametrized families of TQFTs. We discuss how the classification of these anomalies depends on the choice of topology on the universal $\mathrm{U}(1)$ $(d-1)$-form symmetry. In this framework, we use the projective ground-state bundle obtained by compactifying the TQFT on a spatial manifold to derive a general constraint relating its ground-state degeneracy $N$ to its torsion anomaly $\omega$, expressed as $N\int_W\omega\in\mathbb{Z}$ for bundles $W$ of spatial manifolds over closed surfaces. We apply this constraint to ground-state degeneracies of (2+1)-dimensional TQFTs with framing and 1-form symmetry anomalies and to obstructions to symmetry-preserving TQFTs. We also discuss implications for bordism generators and propose a conjecture on anomaly detection by manifolds fibered over surfaces.
summary:
1. 作者将玻色拓扑量子场论的参数空间反常表述为参数族提升障碍，并利用空间紧化后的射影基态丛研究基态简并度$N$的限制。
2. 相位群取离散拓扑时，推得挠反常$\omega$的整除条件$N\int_Wg^*\omega\in\mathbb{Z}$，其中$W$为空间流形在闭曲面上的丛。
3. 在$(2+1)$维理论中，亏格至少三且带阿贝尔任意子通量的空间曲面满足$Nc_-/2\in\mathbb{Z}$，其中$c_-$为手征中心荷，而向非阿贝尔通量的推广仍属猜想。

title: Charge Pumping Leptogenesis from the Symmetric Mass Generation Phase on a Four-Leg Ladder Lattice
abstract: Quantized charge pumping in quantum Hall systems is a bulk topological property, typically manifesting on gapless boundaries as spectral flow through chiral edge modes upon flux insertion. When the boundary is anomaly-free, it can be symmetrically gapped by symmetric mass generation (SMG) interactions. However, the effects on quantized charge pumping at an interacting gapped boundary are unclear. We address this using density-matrix renormalization group simulations of a four-leg ladder quasi-(2+1)d realization of the (1+1)d 3-4-5-0 lattice chiral fermion model with six-fermion interactions at one edge. We find gapless modes near the interacting edge for both weak and strong couplings, but the edge can be in a fully gapped SMG phase at intermediate coupling. We also identify spontaneous breaking of the model's $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry above a critical interaction strength. Across all three boundary phases, we find quantized charge pumping with the same pumped charge per flux quantum. The spatial distribution of the pumped charge varies between phases. Besides charge pumping, we study how a single injected fermion propagates under open boundary conditions. In the SMG phase, an interaction-induced flavor-mixing current develops at the endpoints of the gapped edge, which is absent in the weak- and strong-coupling limits. This current reveals a charge-redistribution mechanism unique to the SMG phase. Additionally, we propose an analogy between charge pumping in this model and a topological leptogenesis scenario in the (3+1)d Standard Model. The anomaly-free chiral U(1) symmetries of the 3-4-5-0 model play a role analogous to the baryon-minus-lepton symmetry of the Standard Model. In both settings, charge pumping can be associated with a continuous deformation along a classically defined but quantum-anomalous direction, while a discrete subgroup remains an exact quantum symmetry.
summary:
1. 为检验对称生隙边界是否保留量子化电荷泵浦，作者用密度矩阵重整化群及强耦合分析研究单边含六费米子相互作用的四腿3-4-5-0梯子模型。
2. 有限尺寸结果支持中等耦合下存在对称质量生成相，沿所选插值，弱、中、强耦合区每移除一个Z₁₀磁通量子均泵送约2单位Q⁽¹⁾电荷。
3. 泵浦由体混合霍尔响应控制但依赖连续插值路径，同一离散扭转沿另一保对称路径无净泵浦，而高维轻子生成仍仅属类比设想。

title: Quantum 3xplorer: AI-Native Engine for Next-Generation Quantum Materials Modeling
abstract: Quantum-mechanical approaches, such as density functional theory (DFT), underpin much of modern computational materials science and are the primary source of data for AI-driven discovery. Yet the established electronic-structure codes today represent decades-old software architectures, making new physical models slow and costly to implement, validate, and deploy on emerging hardware. We present Quantum 3xplorer (Q3, pronounced "Quantum Explorer"), an AI-native quantum simulation engine written from scratch by AI coding agents under the direction and supervision of domain scientists. As a first and demanding validation case, we implement plane-wave pseudopotential DFT end to end: norm-conserving, ultrasoft, and projector-augmented-wave formalisms, spin polarization, DFT+U, and dispersion corrections, together with forces, stresses, structural relaxation, and electronic-structure analysis. Q3 reproduces established reference implementations, runs faster on a single core in representative benchmarks, and scales across GPU-accelerated supercomputers. It was developed in weeks rather than years. Its layered, physics-first architecture separates abstract quantum-mechanical concepts from their numerical representations, making its framework extendable beyond plane waves to other basis sets and levels of theory. Its inputs and outputs follow structured, schema-validated data standards, making every result AI-ready. Q3 is open source under Apache 2.0 and built to be reused, extended, and improved by the research community. Q3 points to a paradigm shift in how computational quantum science is done. Scientists define the physics, formulate the models, and set the criteria for validation; AI agents write, test, and optimize the code. The decades-long path from a new theory to a trusted, high-performance implementation can thus collapse to days, significantly accelerating scientific discovery.
summary:
1. 针对材料电子结构计算的实现与移植瓶颈，作者监督AI编程代理在数周内构建分层C++引擎Q3，实现平面波赝势密度泛函计算并作跨代码和有限差分验证。
2. 硅、铜基准能带相对Quantum ESPRESSO的偏差低于1 meV，八块A100的k点池并行效率达98%，且总能量与单卡一致。
3. 该架构有望缩短新物理模型的开发周期，但端到端可微接口仍待实现，仅Γ点采样的计算尚不支持多GPU。

title: Quantum Cosmology at the Cusp
abstract: In top-down quantum gravity constructions, saxionic directions typically lead to cusps in moduli space, where the scalar potential and the axion decay constant asymptotically behave as $V\sim e^{-\alpha\phi}$ and $f\sim e^{-\gamma\phi}$ in reduced Planck units. Such cusps admit axion-supported scaling cosmologies that expand faster than the corresponding solutions with the axion held fixed, for the same scalar potential. In spatially compact universes, axionic momentum is quantized, and any semiclassical state in the cusp with a localized axion carries nonzero axionic kinetic energy. We show using the Wheeler-DeWitt equation that this contribution drives the late-time evolution towards the axion-supported scaling solution whenever $(d-2)\alpha(\alpha+2\gamma)>4(d-1)$ in $d$ spacetime dimensions. We derive an upper bound on the transition time. Long-lived accelerated expansion requires $2\gamma>(d-2)\alpha$. The trans-Planckian censorship conjecture requires the opposite inequality, $2\gamma\leq(d-2)\alpha$, which also follows independently from requiring the brane magnetically charged under the axion to remain heavier than the Hubble scale.
summary:
1. 作者在空间紧致宇宙的小超空间近似下，利用Wheeler–DeWitt方程研究尖点模空间中轴子局域化如何影响指数势驱动的晚期膨胀。
2. 在轴子支撑标度分支存在且有效理论适用时，局域态的非零动量涨落迫使半经典演化趋于该吸引子，转变e折叠数的上界估计对初始体积及能量占比仅呈对数依赖。
3. 磁荷膜张力尺度高于哈勃尺度的条件与超普朗克审查猜想均排斥该分支的永恒加速，所检验的弦论极限满足此约束，但多轴子及非均匀情形仍待研究。

title: Guaranteed Slater Conditions for the Numerical Conformal Bootstrap: Fixing Instabilities in SDPB, Navigator Methods, and Skydiving
abstract: The semidefinite programs (SDPs) of the numerical conformal bootstrap, and of S-matrix and quantum-mechanics bootstraps, are solved with primal-dual interior-point methods whose convergence guarantees rest on primal and dual Slater conditions: the existence of strictly feasible points on both sides of the duality. Many bootstrap SDPs violate these. The consequences range from slow convergence to inconclusive verdicts and the breakdown of the Skydive algorithm. We introduce "Slater tools", all acting within the PMP class accepted by SDPB. Diagnostics measure the Slater margins and, when a margin vanishes, extract the exposing certificate that identifies the degeneracy. Two independent cures follow. Transforms that provide rigorous bounds on the original SDP objective and that for the right parameter choices return the exact value. Facial reductions that use the exposing certificate to remove the degeneracies themselves. We reproduce, explain and resolve all known types of failures in a mixed-correlator 3d Ising setup. We show that the $X$-Slater condition (SDPB's primal) fails at every disallowed point in feasibility mode, holds in every navigator problem we tested, and can be guaranteed by one additional condition on the navigator function. We show that the folklore "instability remedy" of a twist gap works by removing degeneracies at the endpoints of the positivity conditions. These often stem from a mistake in factoring out the block prefactor but can also arise legitimately in channels that mix equal and unequal operator pairs. Finally we classify and remove all degeneracies of the published current-scalar bootstrap, among them one at $x=\infty$, thus incurable by any gap assumption, caused by unequal polynomial degrees within one matrix block.
summary:
1. 针对严格可行性缺失导致的数值共形自举失稳，作者在SDPB支持的多项式矩阵规划内构建Slater诊断、变换与面约化工具。
2. 作者在三维Ising混合关联函数算例中解释并修复全部已知类型的失效，所给变换为原目标值提供严格界，并在适当参数下恢复精确值。
3. 导航函数满足所给附加条件可保证原始侧严格可行，而电流—标量自举中的无穷远退化表明，间隙假设并非通用稳定化手段。

title: The running of Weyl gauged gravity: asymptotic freedom, its obstruction, and a way out
abstract: We compute the one-loop beta functions of quadratic gravity in Weyl conformal geometry, the gauge theory of diffeomorphisms and dilatations with a dynamical Weyl gauge boson. The divergences are extracted diagrammatically in the background field method, with a gauge fixing procedure adapted to the semidirect product structure of the gauge group. The Weyl-tensor coupling and the Weyl gauge coupling are asymptotically free, and the running of the latter is special, being independent of the other couplings and of any two-derivative matter content. The obstruction to an ultraviolet completion comes from the square of a Weyl-covariant curvature scalar, denoted $\widehat{R}{}^2$: the flow of the corresponding coupling has no fixed point in the physically interesting region and becomes trivial, the only real fixed points require a decoupled Weyl boson and a tachyonic scalar mode. This also holds when including the Standard Model with any nonminimal Higgs coupling and, more generally, for any matter with two-derivative kinetic terms. Weyl-invariant four-derivative scalars with a sufficiently large coupling to $\widehat{R}{}^2$ can remove the obstruction, producing a fixed point in the physical region that is ultraviolet attractive in all directions and has a nonvanishing Weyl gauge coupling.
summary:
1. 为检验Weyl规范二次引力的微扰紫外完备性，作者用背景场图解法与自旋投影求得一圈引力β函数及物质修正。
2. Weyl张量平方耦合与规范耦合均渐近自由，后者不受双导数物质影响，但协变曲率标量平方耦合在物理区无固定方向并于有限能标失去微扰控制。
3. 四导数标量与该项的正耦合足够大时，可在固定标量耦合的减除尺度流中产生全向紫外吸引的物理固定方向，但完整物质流尚待计算，且该机制不能直接延伸至物理动量跑动。

title: DiscKosky: Efficient Genealogical Constraints from Sector-By-Sector Critical Point Counting
abstract: We present DiscKosky, a new Mathematica package for efficiently generating genealogical constraints on the sequential discontinuities of Feynman integrals. DiscKosky works by tracking the solutions to the critical point equations associated with a Feynman integral; by identifying which of these critical points cease to exist in a given kinematic limit, we can associate each Landau singularity with a set of on-shell sectors. The hierarchical principle then forbids sequential discontinuities with respect to singularities that are associated with incompatible sets of on-shell propagators. In rare cases, this algorithm fails to make predictions due to the appearance of higher-dimensional critical varieties---nevertheless, we show that this phenomenon can sometimes be used to identify non-repeating discontinuities, which can be computed at most once in a Feynman integral. We illustrate the power of DiscKosky by applying the package to a broad class of Feynman integrals, including two-loop five-point integrals with one and two massive legs, and three-loop examples that go beyond the current computational frontier. DiscKosky can also be used to probe the analytic properties of more general classes of Euler integrals, which we illustrate by considering several examples that arise in the context of cosmological correlators.

1. 为判定费曼积分中哪些序贯间断必为零，作者开发Mathematica包DiscKosky，以有限域Gröbner基逐扇区计数临界点并结合层级原理。
2. 在所测两圈五点积分族中，算法识别不可重复间断，产生4529条谱系约束并排除14195种符号字母有序配对，均经微分方程验证至维数正规化任意阶。
3. 这些约束有望辅助椭圆型积分自举，但一般运动学下出现非孤立临界点或计数不全时，方法仍不能判定。

title: Giant Gravitons in AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$ and the Superconformal Index of Toric Quiver Gauge Theories
abstract: We derive giant-graviton contributions to superconformal indices by quantizing probe D3-branes in type IIB backgrounds $\mathrm{AdS}_{5}\times SE_{5}$. For $SE_{5}=T^{1,1}$ and $Y^{p,q}$, we determine the scalar, vector, and fermionic fluctuations of maximal giant gravitons and extract their BPS spectra. The resulting single-letter indices agree with those predicted by the giant-graviton expansions of the dual toric quiver gauge theories. These results show that the single-giant terms in finite-$N$ supersymmetric counting functions can be recovered directly from quantized D3-brane degrees of freedom and point toward a universal worldvolume origin of giant-graviton expansions directly on the supergravity side. We view the results as a step in an intrinsically gravitational framework, much like the open-closed-open triality, for addressing supersymmetric microstate-counting problems that are conventionally outsourced to the dual field theory.

1. 为追溯有限N超共形指数修正的引力起源，作者在AdS₅×T^{1,1}及AdS₅×Y^{p,q}中，以探针D3膜二次作用量量子化最大巨引力子的标量、矢量和费米涨落，提取BPS谱。
2. 各单膜扇区的单字母指数均匹配对偶箭图理论预言，同一局域计数函数经透镜空间电荷格的ℤ_{p±q}或ℤ_p投影给出结果，区分了局域计数与全局拓扑的作用。
3. 所见统一结构向一般SE₅的推广仍待检验，完整有限N指数还需纳入重合膜的非阿贝尔动力学及相交膜间弦模。

title: On Boundary State Screening via Solitons
abstract: We present a coarse classification scheme for the boundary data of massive QFTs based on transitions of boundary states via soliton / kink profiles. Starting from the lattice of boundary states, we introduce the boundary screening group $\mathbb{B}$: the equivalence classes of boundary states which cannot be connected by such transitions. In string theory backgrounds which geometrically engineer an interacting QFT in the target space, $\mathbb{B}$ computes the worldsheet analog of the target space defect group $\mathbb{D}$. When $\mathbb{B}$ is non-zero, it provides a diagnostic for having a target space with non-normalizable modes. For interfaces between QFTs, similar considerations imply the existence of a non-trivial conserved charge associated with soliton absorption / transmission, which means that the interface cannot fully dissolve / disappear. Similar considerations hold for junctions of QFTs, which in the special case of string worldsheet CFTs translate to junctions of string theories. We illustrate these general considerations with a number of non-geometric 2D $\mathcal{N} = (2,2)$ Landau-Ginzburg models, as well as their natural lifts to 4D $\mathcal{N} = 1$ Wess-Zumino models.
summary:
1. 为刻画有质量场论边界态的孤子屏蔽障碍，作者以孤子指数配对的余核构造屏蔽群，并在二维超对称朗道–金兹堡与四维Wess–Zumino模型中检验。
2. 世界面计算在ℂ³/ℤ₃镜像中得到屏蔽群ℤ⊕ℤ₃⊕ℤ₃，复现靶空间缺陷群，而紧致1⁹模型的群为零。
3. 折叠理论中的非零屏蔽荷阻止界面或交汇点经孤子过程完全消失，但向一般高维场论推广仍须独立建立边界态整格与整数屏蔽映射。

title: Conformal boundaries and the photon sphere of AdS black holes
abstract: We study linearized gravitational perturbations of four-dimensional Schwarzschild-AdS black holes with finite timelike boundaries subject to conformal boundary conditions. These fix the conformal class of the induced metric and the mean curvature, while allowing the boundary Weyl mode to fluctuate. The photon sphere plays a distinguished role in this problem: a static boundary at this radius is totally umbilic, and the scalar problem separates exactly into independent bulk and boundary sectors. We prove the absence of exponentially growing scalar and vector modes for spherical harmonics of degree two and higher. We determine how large angular momentum instabilities are suppressed as the boundary approaches umbilicity. Near the horizon, we recover the universal Rindler spectrum, including sound and shear excitations. We numerically follow these fluid modes as the boundary is moved outwards and find that they approach standard gravitational quasinormal modes at the asymptotic AdS$_4$ boundary. For large black holes, these asymptotic endpoints correspond to the sound and shear poles of the dual three-dimensional conformal field theory. We also study perturbations of the AdS$_4$ black brane, where we find an analogous continuation of the fluid modes in the absence of an intermediate umbilic boundary.
summary:
1. 为厘清有限边界几何对引力稳定性的作用，作者用线性扰动主方程、渐近分析和数值延拓研究四维史瓦西–AdS黑洞及黑膜，固定边界度规共形类与平均曲率。
2. 光子球处的全脐边界使标量体模与边界模精确解耦，l≥2的标量及矢量模均无指数增长，但l=0的均匀标量模仍有增长解。
3. 所追踪的近视界声模与剪切模连续通向渐近准正规模，建立与对偶共形流体的谱联系，但球对称端点需大黑洞极限，黑膜端点需长波极限。

title: Monopole-Fermion Scattering from Twisted Conformal Boundary States
abstract: We derive monopole-fermion scattering correlators from conformal boundary states in twisted sectors. The key ingredient is that symmetry-preserving boundary conditions contain sectors twisted by topological symmetry lines. Their overlaps determine correlators of operators attached to these lines, including the outgoing excitations required by charge conservation in the Callan-Rubakov effect. We construct the twisted boundary states of $N$ free Dirac fermions with $U(1)^N$-preserving boundary conditions, extending the familiar description in terms of charge lattices to shifted lattices describing twisted sectors. Using cluster decomposition and open-closed duality, we determine their coefficients and fix their normalization relative to the untwisted boundary state. We find that the Callan-Rubakov boundary condition yields a two-point function between an incoming fermion and an outgoing defect operator with a coefficient of unit modulus, even when the corresponding correlators of ordinary local fermions vanish. Finally, we relate these correlators to four-dimensional partial-wave scattering using gauge-covariant asymptotic states. We identify the missing $s$-wave contribution to the unitarity relation and argue that the twisted channel supplies it with precisely the required normalization.
summary:
1. 为解释磁单极子—费米子散射的表观幺正性破坏，作者在无质量弱耦合近似下，以移位电荷格构造N种自由狄拉克费米子的扭曲共形边界态。
2. 簇分解与开闭对偶固定相对归一化后，卡兰—鲁巴科夫边界下入射费米子与拓扑线末端算符的两点函数系数模为1，即使对应局域关联为零。
3. 规范协变分波分析支持扭曲通道补足缺失的s波幺正性贡献，但其四维振幅识别仍依赖类比，末态的直接场论描述尚缺。

title: Umbilic Observatories
abstract: We study gravitational dynamics for the simplest example of an umbilic boundary in four-dimensional general relativity --- a three-dimensional de Sitter hypersurface embedded in a four-dimensional Minkowski world. Generally speaking, an umbilic surface has the property that its induced metric is proportional to its extrinsic curvature. We consider the case of both conformal boundary conditions, as well as Dirichlet boundary conditions imposed at the timelike hypersurface. For both cases, we find that there are no linearised modes whose imaginary frequency grows with angular momentum. The conformal boundary conditions allow for a dynamical boundary degree of freedom, in addition to the bulk excitations. The umbilic property linearly decouples the boundary Weyl mode from the bulk dynamics, yielding linearly stable dynamics. In contrast, the Dirichlet problem has no boundary mode. The umbilic hypersurfaces may thus constitute an improved starting point for defining gravitational dynamics in the presence of a timelike boundary. Throughout our analysis, we draw parallels to the structure of spatial infinity for asymptotically Minkowski spacetimes and a more finite realisation thereof.
summary:
1. 作者用规范不变主方程与能量估计，比较四维闵可夫斯基时空中三维德西特全脐类时边界在共形和狄利克雷条件下的引力线性稳定性。
2. 全脐背景的共形边界应力为零，使外尔模与体模线性解耦，内区体模总能量的放大上界为1且不依赖角动量。
3. 这为有限边界引力提供候选背景，但共形外尔模仍可随闵氏时间线性增长，狄利克雷条件则无此独立模，非线性稳定性尚未确立。

title: All Symmetries and Boundaries of the Two-Dimensional Free Scalar from Continuous Flat-Gauging
abstract: We propose a remote detectability criterion for two-dimensional conformal field theories, which asserts that any local operator outside of the product of the left- and right-moving Virasoro algebras can be detected by some topological line defect. We discuss its relationship to existing results in the conformal net literature. We then use this criterion to argue that the known $SU(2)$ moduli space of unitary conformal boundary conditions and the $SO(4)$ moduli space of unitary topological line defects of the $SU(2)_1$ Wess-Zumino-Witten model completely capture all unitary conformal boundaries and unitary topological lines of the theory. Invoking the fact that the non-compact boson conformal field theory can be obtained from $SU(2)_1$ by "flat-gauging" a $U(1)$ symmetry, we are also able to completely classify the unitary conformal boundaries and unitary topological line defects of the two-dimensional free scalar field. In particular, we find a 4-dimensional moduli space of topological line defects, most of which were not known previously. We support our proposed classifications by writing down concrete Lagrangian descriptions of all of the boundaries and lines of the non-compact boson. For every boundary condition, we calculate the corresponding boundary state, and for each pair of boundary conditions, we calculate the corresponding interval Hilbert space. We verify that the annulus partition functions of the theory respect open/closed duality. We also calculate the fusion rules of the topological line defects, their action on local operators, their action on the boundary conditions by parallel fusion, and their corresponding twisted-sector Hilbert spaces.
summary:
1. 为分类二维非紧致自由标量场的酉共形边界与酉拓扑线，作者提出远程可探测性判据，并对SU(2)₁模型的U(1)对称性作平坦规范化。
2. 所得拓扑线形成四维模空间，多数此前未知，作者为边界与线给出显式拉格朗日描述，并验证环带配分函数满足开闭对偶。
3. 分类完备性的论证依赖所提判据，进一步检验其在其他二维共形场论中的成立性，可厘清这一路线的适用范围。

title: Proof of the entropic $c$-theorem
abstract: We prove an entropic $c$-theorem in two dimensions by constructing a $c$-function from the mutual information between spacelike separated wedges, defined through the relative entropy. The proof follows Casini and Huerta's, with strong subadditivity of entanglement entropy replaced by increasing differences of the mutual information, which we prove directly in the continuum from the split property and standard properties of relative entropy. The benefit of relative entropy is that every quantity we use is finite and no cutoff ever needs to be introduced. The assumptions of the theorem are only the standard axioms of algebraic quantum field theory, the split property with finite mutual information across a gap (both implied by modular $p$-nuclearity), and a finite ultraviolet bound on the resulting $c$-functions. We also note that, formally, the $c$-function is proportional to the minimal averaged null energy of a state that reproduces the vacuum correlations between the two wedges.
summary:
1. 为刻画二维重整化群流的不可逆性，作者在代数量子场论中以相对熵定义互信息，经有界区域极限构造类空分离楔区的左右行c函数。
2. 在分裂性、有界区域跨隙互信息有限及c函数紫外有界条件下，以互信息递增差分性取代强次可加性，无需截断即证明两函数非负且随长度尺度不增。
3. 两函数在固定点恒定，但其与应力张量中心荷的一般等价性及紫外、红外极限与端点理论的匹配仍待证明。

title: Hilbert space in the flat limit of AdS/CFT. II. Massless particles
abstract: Building on Part I of this series, where we described the emergence of massive scattering states, we demonstrate how unitary lowest-weight representations $\mathcal D(\Delta,s)$ of the conformal group with fixed dimension $\Delta$ and arbitrary integer spin $s$ contract to massless Poincaré particle representations. This requires combining the Inönü--Wigner contraction $\mathfrak{so}(2,3) \to \mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$ with an infinite boost, in which case massless scattering states naturally emerge in a carrollian basis. For $\Delta>s+1$, we find that $\mathcal D(\Delta,s)$ contracts to the direct sum of massless particles of all spins $s'\leq s$. At the unitarity bound, lower-spin states become null so that $\mathcal D(s+1,s)$ contracts to a single massless particle representation carrying the two maximal helicities $J=\pm s$. In both cases, the inner product converges to the Poincaré-invariant one after a single helicity-independent rescaling, so that unitarity is preserved throughout the contraction.
summary:
1. 为阐明AdS₄平直极限中无质量散射态的来源，作者在固定标度维数下将代数收缩与伪动量态的无限推动结合，得到卡罗尔基。
2. 整数自旋s≥1的表示在Δ>s+1时收缩为自旋0至s的无质量粒子直和，幺正界上低自旋态范数归零而仅余J=±s，内积经螺旋度无关重标度收敛并保持幺正性。
3. 该构造为从共形关联函数提取无质量振幅提供外态归一化，但所提处方对显式全息关联函数的应用仍待完成。

title: Facets of Gravity: A journey exploring spacetime from Planckian to cosmological scales
abstract: What does it mean to quantize gravity, and what can a quantum theory of spacetime actually predict? This thesis explores these questions through complementary non-perturbative approaches, from the geometry of quantum spacetime to the emergence of cosmological physics. Within Causal Dynamical Triangulations, we develop observables to investigate effective topology, statistical homogeneity, and curvature in strongly fluctuating geometries, where conventional differential-geometric tools are unavailable. Tests in two-dimensional models reveal distinct coarse-graining behaviours and provide new ways to probe the emergence of familiar geometric properties. We then turn to the Functional Renormalization Group and Asymptotic Safety, developing flow invariants to characterize ultraviolet-critical surfaces and introducing Flow Invariant Neural Networks as a computational method for reconstructing them. In scalar-tensor gravity, we investigate how ultraviolet consistency conditions can constrain infrared interactions, obtaining an inflationary scenario compatible with cosmological observations. Finally, we question whether the metric must be the fundamental variable of quantum gravity. We formulate a lattice statistical approach to purely affine gravity, in which the connection is fundamental and the metric, when it exists, is emergent. Monte Carlo simulations provide exploratory results in two dimensions, while a four-dimensional homogeneous and isotropic construction yields preliminary evidence for de Sitter-like geometry and allows the study of curvature correlations. Together, these investigations develop complementary tools for studying quantum spacetime, testing its possible continuum behaviour, and connecting fundamental gravitational theories with observable physics, while identifying the conceptual and computational challenges that remain.
summary:
1. 作者以因果动力学三角剖分、泛函重整化群及纯仿射格点模型探究量子时空的几何与宇宙学预言，开发几何观测量、流不变量及重构紫外临界面的神经网络。
2. 二维测试揭示不同粗粒化行为，标量—张量引力的紫外一致性约束给出与观测相容的暴胀情景，四维均匀各向同性构造提供类德西特几何的初步证据。
3. 以联络为基本变量的纯仿射方案可探索度规涌现，但二维蒙特卡罗模拟仍属探索性，连续极限尚待检验。

title: $h/2e$ Flux Trapping without Superconductivity
abstract: Recently, it was shown by Komargodski and Popov [ arXiv:2601.09847 ] that ordinary metals threaded with an Aharonov-Bohm solenoid exclusively trap either 0 or h/2e flux. The latter value is familiar in the superconducting setting, yet we find that it holds in ordinary metals as well, with no condensate or pairing necessary. We provide an analytic explanation for the flux trapping, and extend the results to the cases of finite temperature, time-reversal invariant potentials, and lattice regularization, where we find that the flux remains trapped at 0 and h/2e.
summary:
1. 为解释普通金属的半磁通俘获，作者在AB磁通穿过的圆柱与圆盘上积分掉费米子，解析电子反作用及有限尺寸电流，并以紧束缚模拟检验。
2. 无配对模型的能量仍以h/e为磁通周期，200组温度、化学势及短程正则化扫描均优选0或h/2e磁通，近原点电流跳变则在有限晶格上通常消失。
3. 低温微米铜圆柱有望检验该效应，但需周向相干、高磁导环境及足够电感；时间反演若自发破缺，其他俘获值仍可能出现。

title: Induced Lorentzian geometry from the fermionic quantum metric
abstract: Quantum geometry is conventionally understood in parameter or momentum space and need not be related to a geometry in configuration space. Here we show for Dirac fermions in a background electromagnetic field that an induced Lorentzian geometry is generated from the fermionic quantum metric. We study a Lorentz covariant phase space worldline path integral construction, whose application of the adiabatic theorem onto spin degrees of freedom leads to the appearance of the Berry phase at $O(\hbar)$, and the quantum metric at $O(\hbar^2)$ in the worldline action. Both the Feynman and retarded/advanced propagators are examined in 3+1 and 2+1 dimensions, whose different on-shell implementations lead to related quantum metrics; QED/QED${}_3$ and condensed matter Dirac theory are considered. An effective theory is found by integrating out the momenta degrees of freedom, which gives rise to an emergent Lorentzian metric in configuration space, whose perturbation to the flat metric is dependent on the quantum metric and the background field strength. Apart from the spin degrees of freedom encoded into the Berry phase, the effective theory describes a scalar particle moving in the induced quantum geometry. Phenomenological applications to the covariant geometry are further studied using spectral holonomy in a gapped 3-dimensional Dirac material.
summary:
1. 作者用协变相空间世界线路径积分和自旋绝热展开，研究电磁背景中2+1及3+1维有质量狄拉克费米子的量子态几何能否诱导构型空间几何。
2. 消去动量后，量子度规通过电磁场强的二次耦合在ℏ²阶诱导构型空间的有效洛伦兹度规，ℏ阶贝里项则保留自旋输运。
3. 理论预言有隙三维狄拉克材料窄环中的反向模式存在正比于径向电场与轴向磁场之积的额外能级劈裂，可作谱学探针，但限于带边弱场绝热近似。

title: Reconstructing Meson Parton Distributions from Mellin Moments with Artificial Neural Networks
abstract: We address the inverse problem of reconstructing a meson parton distribution function (PDF) or parton distribution amplitude (PDA) at a fixed scale from a finite set of Mellin moments. At finite moment order this map is ill posed in the Hadamard sense: the moments do not determine a unique, stable pointwise $x$-dependence, and small data perturbations can produce large changes in the reconstruction. We regularize the problem by restricting the admissible function class through constraints justified by first principles---support on $x\in[0,1]$, endpoint vanishing, unit normalization, and, for the pion, the exact $x\leftrightarrow 1-x$ symmetry---and by complementing these hard constraints with differentiable penalties that suppress the spurious multiple maxima and central concavity changes typical of ill-posed inversions. We parameterize the unknown function with two interchangeable neural cores, a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and a Kolmogorov--Arnold network (KAN), and find that the KAN reconstructs the target distributions more accurately, most markedly in the asymmetric (kaon) case. We attribute this advantage to the locality of the B-spline basis underlying the KAN, which localizes corrections during moment matching and damps the global oscillations to which the MLP is prone. Benchmarks against synthetic targets, using both ten and five input moments, support these conclusions.
summary:
1. 针对有限梅林矩反演介子PDF或PDA的病态性，作者结合端点、归一化等硬约束与形状软惩罚，在合成目标上比较MLP与KAN。
2. KAN更忠实地重建非对称分布轮廓，十矩训练的四项基准中，第十矩相对误差为1%，低于MLP的3%。
3. 该方法可望用于实际非微扰矩的反演，但验证仍限于合成目标，且参数量未匹配，尚不能将KAN优势单独归因于样条局域性。

title: Longitudinal electric corner modes in continuum quantum gauge theory with matter
abstract: Subregions in gauge theories give rise to edge modes and corner charges supported on their boundaries. While this is well-established classically and in quantum lattice gauge theories, the fate of corner modes remains poorly understood in continuum quantum field theories owing to their distributional nature. In this paper, we revisit this challenge and propose a new corner operator for a regional Cauchy slice algebra generated by local gauge-invariant observables of scalar QED in Minkowski spacetime. The corner mode is given by the longitudinal electric field sourced by the matter outside the subregion and thus constitutes a centre for the regional algebra. Our main goal is to show that there exists a perturbative GNS state on this algebra that quantises this mode. Pulling back the Fock vacuum to the slice, we construct this state by renormalising the divergences arising from the lack of temporal smearing. We clarify that the inclusion of the new centre mode necessitates a further renormalisation on the corner of the region, thereby physically distinguishing it and breaking the translation invariance of the state. Our work shows how the requirements of locality, renormalisability, and positivity together put strong constraints on the existence of a continuum quantum field theory which supports corner modes as genuine quantum operators. We finish with comments about the von Neumann completion of the regional algebra, as well as possible physical interpretations of the renormalised vacuum state.
summary:
1. 为研究连续规范理论角模的量子化，作者从标量电动力学的柯西切片代数出发，提出域外电荷产生的纵向电场中心模，并以微分重整化构造候选GNS态。
2. 在最低非零耦合阶，体区及边界重整化给出有限二点函数，局域反项可恢复边界核正性，其大波数标度为k²ln(k/2m)（m为标量质量）。
3. 该有效理论构造需修改紫外结构并固定边界，态不再平移不变，完整代数上的态正性尚未证明，协变推广仍待研究。

title: Gravitational Memory from AdS States in the Flat-Space Limit
abstract: We study linearized gravitational reconstruction in global AdS$_4$ with dynamical scalar matter, building on vacuum Einstein perturbations with fixed boundary metric and nontrivial normalizable data. External scalar sources prepare an excited state and modify the holographic Ward identities, while subsequent evolution can proceed without boundary driving. Separating the bulk matter-sourced response from vacuum perturbations, we derive an electric quadrupole master equation with the matter-dependent corrections required by the Einstein constraints. We also verify that a cylindrical boundary integral reproduces the Regge--Wheeler master field mode by mode, without identifying it with the full global Fefferman--Graham reconstruction. For weakly interacting scalars that become massless in the flat-space limit, we extract the Bondi shear and news from retarded gravitational evolution. The resulting supertranslation memory agrees numerically with the outgoing energy redistribution and the quadrupole moment of the boundary work. In the ordered flat-space limit, later boundary controls leave the first event's waveform unchanged, despite cancelling residual gravitational modes at finite AdS radius.
summary:
1. 为从边界态重建散射引力记忆，作者在AdS₄弱耦合双标量模型中分离物质特解与齐次响应，推导约束一致的电型四极主方程并数值演化。
2. 高斯算例有限时窗内的归一化邦迪剪切跃变为18.1171，与能流预测18.1166相符，首轮边界做功四极矩的平直外推亦给出一致记忆。
3. 后续控制虽能清除有限半径的残余模，却不改变先取平直极限所得的首次散射波形；结论限于所考察的微扰无质量标量过程，非线性引力仍待研究。

title: Light-Transformed Carrollian OPEs and the Four-Gluon Spectral Bootstrap
abstract: Scattering amplitudes of massless particles can be rewritten as correlation functions of light-transformed operators at null infinity, on which the Carrollian symmetries act. We ask how much of the four-gluon tree amplitude is determined by the operator product expansion of these operators. When two gluons become collinear, the exchanged gluon and all of its descendants combine into a single function of the null time of $\mathcal{I}^+$ and angular separations of the pair on the celestial sphere. We show that this function is fixed by the Ward identities, which reduce to Kummer's differential equation, and by the signs of the energies, which select one combination of its two solutions. We then expand the same amplitude in massive two-particle states of the physical scattering channel and find that the collinear data control the expansion at large spin. Each of the two collinear poles of the amplitude determines one of the two infinite sequences of partial-wave coefficients in closed form. Once both poles are imposed, crossing symmetry and the scaling of the correlator in Carroll time fix the tree spectrum uniquely among amplitudes with only the physical collinear poles, up to a single subtraction constant at the collinear boundary.
summary:
1. 为检验类光无穷远算符乘积能否重构交替螺旋度四胶子树振幅，作者用有限时间光变换和Ward恒等式构造完整交换族，并匹配归一化双粒子分波。
2. 能量符号选定Kummer方程的Tricomi解，两类共线极点精确给出符号交替的调和数系数与大自旋下按J⁻⁴衰减的非交替系数。
3. 在仅含物理共线简单极点的有理树振幅类中，交叉与卡罗尔时间标度使正质量谱仅剩一个共线减除常数的歧义；一圈推广仍需计算切割不连续性并统一红外处方。

title: A Common Type II Origin of Galilean and Carroll Superstrings
abstract: We show that the relativistic Type-II superalgebras, once the fundamental-string winding charge is retained alongside the momentum, admit a single non-Lorentzian contraction whose two translation ideals carry Galilean and magnetic-Carroll supersymmetry, respectively. The complementary vector charge required for this structure is thus intrinsic to string theory. The IIA realization is particle-like and the IIB realization string-like, a distinction fixed by chirality, and spacelike T-duality relates the two while preserving each non-Lorentzian structure. The same contraction is finite on the doubled Green--Schwarz action, including all fermion terms and local kappa symmetry, where the two supersymmetries appear as the two polarizations of a single worldsheet theory. These results unify two distinct non-Lorentzian corners of string theory within a common Type-II origin and open a route toward a broader web of non-Lorentzian dualities and possible holographic generalizations.
summary:
1. 为统一伽利略与磁型卡罗尔超弦，作者保留Ⅱ型超代数的动量和基本弦绕数荷，并对代数及双重化Green–Schwarz作用量实施同一非洛伦兹收缩。
2. 两分支由互补商代数及世界面两种极化显露，作用量无需发散减除且保留全部费米项与局域κ对称，类空T对偶连接IIA与IIB并保持各分支结构。
3. 卡罗尔分支的谱与量子化尚待研究，非平凡幺正实现还需绕数中心扩张或选取部分超荷为纯规范的扇区。

title: New Effects in Multifield Cosmology Coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet Term
abstract: We study the rapid-turn regime of multifield cosmology coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet term. We derive the corresponding modified relations between the inflationary Hubble and potential slow-roll parameters, in the two-field case. These relations show that including the Gauss-Bonnet coupling broadens the possibilities for realizing rapid turn inflation and for satisfying the swampland conjectures. We also derive a consistency condition relating the scalar field-space metric to the scalar potential and the Gauss-Bonnet coupling, which two-field slow-roll and rapid-turn inflationary solutions have to satisfy. Finally, we find general conditions under which phantom-like behavior is possible in multifield dark energy models coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet term. Notably, although we do not consider a direct interaction between dark matter and dark energy, dark matter is crucial for the occurrence of a phantom regime.
summary:
1. 为研究高曲率项如何改变宇宙加速，作者解析研究高斯–博内耦合双场模型，推导慢滚参数关系、快转一致性条件及暗能量状态方程。
2. 耦合允许转弯率不大时仍有ε≪1而ε_V∼1，并表明在ε>0的背景下，幻影态w_DE<−1需不可忽略的暗物质，却无需暗部门直接耦合。
3. 关联场空间度规、势与耦合函数的一致性条件可用于数值筛选暴胀模型，但它仅是必要条件，具体解的存在仍须检验。

title: Bootstrapping a Higher-Derivative Cosmological Collider: Borel-Laplace Resummation and Stokes Phenomena
abstract: We develop a higher-derivative cosmological bootstrap for massive spectators with quartic dispersion, $\omega^2\propto k^4$, revealing a new boundary-value problem for inflationary correlators. The exchange equation becomes fourth order, and the collapsed limit becomes an irregular singular point, where collider and WKB branches coexist and exhibit Stokes phenomena. Since the folded configuration is now an ordinary point, the relativistic criterion of Bunch--Davies regularity at the folded singularity is no longer available. We instead impose an asymptotic boundary condition that removes the WKB branches and matches the surviving collider branches to Schwinger-Keldysh data. We also construct a convergent Borel-Laplace particular solution that resums a factorially divergent expansion and satisfies both bootstrap equations simultaneously; its leading collapsed-limit behavior is reproduced by direct in-in integrals. In the bispectrum, the squeezed-limit collider signal retains its mass-dependent frequency, while its amplitude and phase depend on the dispersion scale; near the equilateral configuration, the full shape is also sensitive to this scale and can change sign. Our results expose a new analytic structure of non-relativistic cosmological correlators and signatures beyond the squeezed limit.
summary:
1. 为厘清四次色散重旁观场如何改变暴胀关联函数，作者以剔除WKB分支的渐近边界条件和Borel–Laplace重求和求解四阶自举方程。
2. 塌缩点成为呈现斯托克斯现象的非正则奇点，折叠点变为常点，收敛特解同时满足两顶点源方程，其领先塌缩项与直接in-in积分一致。
3. 所选延拓提示双谱等边振幅可随色散尺度变号，但有限动量下与完整闭时路径解的等同性仍待验证。

title: Far-Zone Gravitational Interactions at the Sixth Post-Newtonian Order
abstract: We compute the nonlinear far-zone dynamics of compact binaries at the sixth post-Newtonian (6PN) order in the effective field theory of general relativity. We derive the complete $\mathcal{O}(G^2)$ far-zone action of a generic multipolar source in both the causal and the conservative prescriptions. Besides the known tails and failed tails, it contains five new sectors generated by the nonlinear memory of the emitted waves. On scattering orbits, they contain a boundary term, nonlocal in time, fixed by the balance of angular momentum. The same construction yields the emitted waveforms, whose energy and angular-momentum fluxes balance the losses of the action. For the binary, the 6PN dynamics also requires PN corrections to the lower-order sectors, the iterated radiation reaction, and a coupling quadratic in the curvature of the composite source, whose coefficient we fix by matching the gravitational Compton amplitude to that of the constituents. We compute the two-radiation contributions to the total scattering angle at fourth, fifth and sixth post-Minkowskian (PM) order and to the conservative angle at 4PM and 5PM, retaining the integer-PN terms through 6PN. For the conservative angle, we give both the local and $\gamma$-3 prescriptions. Combined with the tail and the known potential contributions, our results reproduce the conservative and total 4PM angles and the second-self-force part of the conservative 5PM angle. Including the dissipative tail, we recover the total 5PM angle through 5PN and determine its new 6PN coefficient. At 6PM, the two-radiation contribution to the total angle extends the known 5PN result to 6PN.
summary:
1. 针对无自旋双星6PN非线性辐射反作用，作者以闭时路径有效场论递推构造G²阶远区作用量，并用振幅匹配确定复合源曲率平方耦合。
2. 计算获得五类新记忆项，以角动量平衡固定非局域散射边界项，并确定5PM总散射角中新的6PN对称质量比平方项系数。
3. 这些远区输入可用于补全6PN保守动力学，但仍需高于G⁴阶的近区势，完整6PM散射角也尚缺势区与尾项贡献。

title: Which Adiabatic Cycles Alter an Action Variable?
abstract: Action variables are adiabatic invariants: their values are preserved during adiabatic time evolutions in completely integrable classical Hamiltonian systems. Nevertheless, an adiabatic cycle can alter how an action variable depends on phase-space variables that are independent of adiabatic parameters. Such a change, which we call action variable holonomy, induces adiabatic torus pumping in phase space. For a family of completely integrable kicked-top systems, a homotopy classification of adiabatic cycles identifies which adiabatic cycles induce action variable holonomy and adiabatic torus pumping. A physical example is also provided.
summary:
1. 为判定哪些绝热循环会改变作用量的相空间函数形式，作者对完全可积经典踢陀螺中剔除恒等旋转的参数空间作同伦分类。
2. 基本群为Z₂，仅非可缩循环使作用量函数反号，并将非零标记环面泵浦至原作用量坐标的相反标记，而作用量取值仍绝热不变。
3. 静场叠加周期脉冲场的自旋模型给出单脉冲转角缓变2π的理论实现方案，但该分类向一般完全可积系统的推广仍待研究。

title: Pareto-Optimal Hypersonic Vehicle Design with Canonical-Coordinate Neural Operator Surrogates Under Ablation-Driven Shape Change and Incidence Variation
abstract: High-fidelity CFD is essential for coupled hypersonic aerodynamic and aerothermal phenomena, but its cost precludes multi-objective design optimization. We develop three DeepONet surrogates for two hypersonic configurations, unified by one device: the trunk receives coordinates in which the varying feature is held fixed. The first is a prescribed family of 37 spherically blunted tangent ogives, varied through ogive radius of curvature to span nose-tip ablation forebody change; no ablation is computed. A body-fitted canonical transformation maps every domain onto a common (s, eta) space, retaining physical coordinates for forces and heat transfer. A branch network predicts reduced coefficients and a Transolver trunk with Physics-Attention learns the spatial basis; a two-step strategy optimizes both jointly, orthonormalizes the basis by QR factorization, and trains a second-stage branch for unseen geometries. Surrogates cover density, pressure, velocity, temperatures, conductivities and species mass fractions. In leave-one-out tests, drag, mean and peak wall heat flux are recovered to 1.16%, 1.62% and 5.29%; a sweep of 1001 geometries gives a 200-design Pareto front trading 6.68% in drag for 4.42% in peak heating (a diagnostic, not an objective). The second is the 3D AEDC waverider at 29 angles of attack: static mesh, moving leading-edge shock. For surface quantities, the same construction predicts integrated heat load within 0.22% and force coefficients to errors below 2.6x10^-5; Pareto fronts identify angles of attack trading drag, lift and heating. For the volume field, a Cartesian trunk smears the shock; a frozen ShockNet supplies a shock-aligned coordinate and a hotspot-aware mixture of experts corrects the residual, recovering density to 12.28% relative L2 error at a held-out incidence (5.08x10^7 nodes). The 1001-design sweep takes about three minutes on a single CPU.
summary:
1. 针对外形及攻角变化下的高超声速气动热预测，作者以规范坐标对齐几何或激波特征，构建钝头体与乘波体的DeepONet代理。
2. 钝头体留一测试中，阻力和峰值壁面热流误差分别为1.16%和5.29%，单CPU约三分钟扫描1001种外形并获得200点帕累托前沿。
3. 该框架支持快速多目标筛选，但未计算实际烧蚀过程，且一个留出攻角下的密度场相对L2误差仍为12.28%。

title: Scaling Limits as Extensions of Continuous Bundles of C*-algebras
abstract: We analyze scaling limits in algebraic quantum field theory using continuous bundles of C*-algebras. Different conditions of continuity on such bundles encode different strengths of approximation of the theory by its scaling limit. As a proof of concept, we consider the small-distance scaling limit of the theory of a massive free scalar field, which corresponds to a massless free scalar field. We provide a number of examples of local algebras of observables for which the corresponding bundle of C*-algebras representing the scaling limit is merely lower semicontinuous. Further, we construct an algebra of nonlocal observables for which the corresponding bundle of C*-algebras representing the scaling limit is uniformly continuous.
summary:
1. 为刻画短距离标度极限对原理论的逼近，作者以C*代数丛的边界延拓为框架，构造三、四维时空中有质量自由标量场的伸缩截面。
2. 三类局域代数均生成下半连续丛，其中两类存在范数不连续截面；反Wick序非局域代数则生成一致连续丛，其极限同构于相应无质量代数。
3. 固定截面代数后，最大极限代数不依赖态且在同构意义下唯一，但局域情形仅证明它满射到无质量网，一致连续构造则缺乏自然局域网结构。

title: Existence and stability of Weyl points
abstract: Weyl points are quasimomentum-energy pairs in the band structure of three-dimensional periodic media at which two dispersion surfaces touch conically. They first arose in a model introduced by H. Weyl in 1929, but were first observed only recently in condensed matter physics and photonics experiments. Weyl points have been explored theoretically via numerical computation and via tight binding (discrete) models. In this article we present the first analytical treatment of Weyl points in a continuum PDE-type model. Starting with a Schrödinger operator whose electric potential is periodic with respect to the body-centered cubic (BCC) lattice, we introduce a small BCC-periodic magnetic vector potential that is equivariant with respect to a specific abelian group of symmetries. For magnetic Schrödinger operators of this type, we prove (i) that a pair of Weyl points bifurcates from a threefold degeneracy in the band structure of the underlying non-magnetic operator, and (ii) that these Weyl points are stable against small self-adjoint BCC-periodic perturbations of both the electric and magnetic vector potentials.
summary:
1. 作者利用布洛赫谱分析与舒尔补约化，在体心立方周期磁薛定谔模型中引入破坏时间反演的弱磁矢势，解析证明外尔点的存在与稳定性。
2. 在指定对称性及非退化条件下，三重二次简并分裂为一对外尔点，其动量间距呈磁扰动幅度的平方根标度，且在任意保持自伴性的小幅同周期电磁势扰动下仍保持锥形简并。
3. 该框架为研究平面缺陷中的费米弧表面态提供起点，但本文尚未证明这些表面态的存在。

title: Connes spectral distance as a quantum distance measure and a geometric measure of entanglement
abstract: In this paper, we study the Connes spectral distance as a quantum distance measure and its applications in discriminating quantum states and calculating quantum entanglement. Based on finite matrix algebra, we construct a spectral triple for finite dimensional quantum states. The Connes spectral distance is a generalization to the quantum trace distance and Hilbert-Schmidt distance. The corresponding optimal elements can always be chosen to commute with the difference matrix $\Delta$, and then the optimal element and $\Delta$ can be simultaneously diagonalized. We obtain the formulas of Connes spectral distances in three different parameter regimes which depending on the spectrum of difference matrix. As applications, we show how to use spectral distances to distinguish state pairs that have the same trace distance and Hilbert-Schmidt distance. We also define a new geometric measure of entanglement based on spectral distance. These results can help us study the relationships among Connes spectral distance, quantum trace distance and other quantum distance measures. These concrete constructions are significant for studies of quantum states in the framework of noncommutative geometry.
summary:
1. 为刻画有限维量子态差异与纠缠，作者在矩阵代数上用狄拉克算符直和构造幺正不变的参数化Connes谱距离，并将距离优化约化为态差矩阵的谱问题。
2. 作者确定三类参数区间及精确谱阈值，迹距离和希尔伯特–施密特距离均相同的两组四维态对在t=0.9时谱距离分别为0.4513和0.4440。
3. 到可分态集的最短谱距离定义了几何纠缠量，其在贝尔对角态上正比于负性，但局域操作与经典通信下的单调性仍待证明。

title: Stochastic dynamics generation of directed percolation using a two-channel convolutional neural network
abstract: Neural networks provide a promising approach to learning and generating the stochastic dynamics of nonequilibrium systems. In this study, we propose a stochastic dynamics generative method based on a two-channel convolutional neural network, using the (1+1)-dimensional directed bond percolation model to investigate its ability to learn local stochastic transition rules and reproduce stochastic dynamics across different system sizes. The proposed method takes the current particle configuration and the control parameter as inputs, learns the conditional activation probabilities at the next time step through local convolutions, and generates stochastic temporal evolution through iterative Bernoulli sampling. The results show that the network-generated dynamics agree well with Monte Carlo simulations across different control parameters. Furthermore, applying the trained network to a substantially larger system with $L=10000$ yields an estimated critical probability of $p_c=0.643$ and an effective density decay exponent of $\delta\approx0.1592$, close to the established theoretical values. These findings demonstrate that the proposed method can reproduce the stochastic dynamics of directed percolation and capture its macroscopic dynamical and statistical properties across different spatial sizes.
summary:
1. 为检验局域规则学习能否重现宏观随机动力学，作者以（1+1）维有向键渗流为平台，用双通道全卷积网络从构型与传播概率学习条件激活概率，并以伯努利采样迭代演化。
2. 网络在L=32训练后无需重训即可用于L=10000，于p=0.643拟合得到有效密度衰减指数δ≈0.1592，小系统密度演化亦与蒙特卡洛吻合。
3. 结果支持局域跃迁规则的跨尺寸复用，但10≤t≤1000的有限时间幂律拟合尚不能确证渐近临界标度。

title: Root-of-unity limit of the $A_{n-1}$ lens elliptic gamma function solution of the star-star relation
abstract: We study the root-of-unity limit of the multi-component spin solution of the star-star relation whose Boltzmann weights are products of lens elliptic gamma functions, and whose spins take values in $\mathbb{R}^{n-1}\times(\mathbb{Z}_r)^{n-1}$. When one of the elliptic nomes tends to a primitive $2rN$-th root of unity, the quasi-classical expansion gives at leading order the classical star-star relation of the Bazhanov-Sergeev multi-spin model; at the next order, under the standard assumptions on the saddle points, a $(\mathbb{Z}_{rN})^{n-1}$-state solution of the star-star relation, which depends on $r$ and $N$ only through $rN$. Real $\mathbb{Z}_n$-symmetric configurations of the continuous spins give elliptic $\mathfrak{sl}(n)$ Kashiwara-Miwa type models labeled by $n$-torsion points. Extended to general primitive torsion points, these include the broken $\mathbb{Z}_{rN}$ model of Quano and Fujii, for which the star-star relation follows from their Yang-Baxter equation when $\gcd(n,rN)=1$. In the trigonometric limit the saddle point equations single out the spectral curve of the $\mathfrak{sl}(n)$ chiral Potts model of Bazhanov, Kashaev, Mangazeev and Stroganov, and the Boltzmann weights become those of that model.
summary:
1. 为研究连续—离散混合自旋如何产生有限态可积模型，作者结合精确差分方程与鞍点展开，分析多分量透镜椭圆伽马模型的单位根极限。
2. 所得经典背景上的$(\mathbb{Z}_M)^{n-1}$模型对$r,N$的依赖仅经$M=rN$，特定背景给出椭圆Kashiwara–Miwa型模型，三角函数极限下的Z不变构型恢复多分量手性Potts权重及谱曲线。
3. 一般星—星关系虽获数值支持，仍依赖未证鞍点假设，构造背景依赖的L算符或可提供直接证明。

title: Mathematical foundations of second quantization: an introduction through spin-boson models
abstract: These lecture notes originate from a one-semester course on the mathematical foundations of second quantization, first given at the Department of Physics of the Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg in the Winter Semester 2025/26 to a mixed audience of physics and mathematics students. Their guiding thread is a class of physical models: spin-boson models, describing a two-level system coupled to a boson field. After summarizing the necessary background on unbounded operators, up to the Kato-Rellich and KLMN theorems, and developing direct sums and tensor products of Hilbert spaces and of unbounded operators, we treat single-mode boson fields, constructing the ladder and number operators and characterizing their domains, before moving to Fock spaces, second quantization, bosonic and fermionic annihilation and creation operators, and the canonical (anti)commutation relations. Throughout, spin-boson models provide both the motivation and the test bench for the formalism: we rigorously establish their self-adjointness, solve the pure dephasing and Jaynes-Cummings models explicitly, deriving their spectra and the qubit channels they induce, show how their multimode counterparts display irreversible decoherence and decay, and, in an appendix, prove the rotating-wave approximation for the quantum Rabi model with an explicit error bound. Finally, we use the KLMN theorem to construct spin-boson models with non-normalizable form factors, and briefly discuss stronger ultraviolet divergences and the need for renormalization. Exercises with full solutions are included.
summary:
1. 为严格描述两能级系统与玻色场的耦合，讲义以无界算符理论和福克空间梳理二次量子化，并证明相关哈密顿量的自伴性。
2. 作者显式求得纯退相干与Jaynes–Cummings模型的谱及量子比特通道，展示多模模型的不可逆退相干与衰减，并给出量子拉比模型旋波近似的显式误差界。
3. KLMN定理还用于构造含不可归一化形状因子的模型，但更强紫外发散仍需重整化，讲义仅简述这一需求。

title: Area laws for free fermions in ergodic field: spectral criteria and localisation-based methods
abstract: We review rigorous results concerning the Area Law for the entanglement entropy of free fermions whose one-body Hamiltonian is an ergodic Schrödinger operator with a strongly localised pure point spectrum. Particular attention is paid to operators with deterministic potentials (quasi-periodic ones and those generated by subshifts of finite type). Our approach relies on reducing the problem to obtaining exponential estimates for the eigenfunction correlator. This provides an effective route from localisation to the Area Law and allows for the identification of additional spectral estimates that need to be proven for various classes of ergodic operators. We realise this approach by using various localisation techniques, including dynamical localisation and the uniformly localised eigenfunction property for bounded and unbounded ergodic operators (e.g. the Maryland model), as well as a new method for obtaining the corresponding exponential bounds for Schrödinger operators generated by subshifts of finite type.
summary:
1. 作者综述确定性遍历势下自由格点费米子基态的纠缠面积律，将证明归结为本征函数关联量的指数衰减，并梳理一致局域化与有限体积格林函数方法。
2. 在相应假设下，平均熵满足L^{d−1}面积标度，覆盖多维Maryland模型的整个无界谱及有限型子移位模型的谱底区，后者依赖远距块解耦估计。
3. 该谱判据仅为充分条件，纯点谱本身不决定面积律，能否弱化定量局域化假设或由面积律反推强局域化仍未解决。

title: A Finite-Range, Translation-Invariant Counterexample to Weak Gibbsianity
abstract: We construct a finite-range, translation-invariant counterexample to the Weak Gibbsianity property for quantum spin systems on $\mathbb{Z}^2$. The proof relies on showing how a local potential can induce macroscopically large deviations from an equilibrium configuration after a perturbation is introduced at the boundary of the lattice.
summary:
1. 为检验量子平衡态的弱吉布斯性，作者构造二维方格上平移不变的自旋1/2近邻条件翻转模型，并用分形生成树计数建立反例。
2. 当βJ>2^{11/2}时，任一吉布斯极限态在特定递增方区序列上的全自旋向上概率至少为孤立区吉布斯值的e^{C|X|}倍（C>0），违反弱吉布斯上界。
3. 这揭示边界作用可造成稀有事件概率的体积指数级差异，但现有方法能否推广至非饱和磁化投影仍不明确。

title: Persistence of Unitary Almost Mathieu Operator Gaps Ten Dry Martinis, Five on the Rim
abstract: We determine exactly which gap labels are realized by open spectral gaps for the unitary almost Mathieu operator at every irrational frequency and all coupling constants ($0<\lambda_1,\lambda_2\leq1$). When both couplings are strictly less than one, every permitted gap label is realized by an open gap, including in the critical case ($\lambda_1=\lambda_2$). When at least one coupling equals one, both lifts of every odd winding label are realized by open gaps, whereas all even winding labels are collapsed. The proof combines quantitative almost reducibility and Aubry duality with a monotonicity principle for gap heights.
summary:
1. 作者以准周期分步量子行走为模型，结合磁代数标量谱表示、微扰种子隙与隙高单调性，判定酉几乎马蒂厄算符的允许隙标签何时对应开隙。
2. 对任意无理频率，两正耦合均小于1时全部允许隙打开，包括等耦合临界线；任一耦合为1时，每个奇绕数的两支隙均打开，偶绕数隙全部塌缩。
3. 边界半周期对称性造成的闭隙表明，对偶性本身不足以保证全部允许隙打开，因此向其他准周期模型推广仍需检验相应的对称性障碍。

title: Baker--Akhiezer sections from Higgs bundles and Landau levels in hyperbolic band theory
abstract: As observed by Kienzle and the second author, rank-two $\mathcal{O}(3)$-twisted Higgs bundles on the projective line encode all hyperbolic crystals of genus two: the spectral curves are the unit cells, and the Hitchin fibers are the abelian Brillouin zones. In a uniform magnetic field of two flux quanta, the lowest Landau level is one-dimensional at every nonzero momentum, and, as found by Iengo and Li, its dimension jumps to two at the zero momentum. We identify the states of the lowest Landau level with the Baker--Akhiezer sections of the Higgs bundles, and their zeros, the vortices, with the Baker--Akhiezer divisors. A family of nonzero momenta limits to the zero momentum exactly when each of the two vortices approaches the image of the other under the spatial inversion, and the states of the jumped level are labeled by the directions of limiting. On the Higgs bundle side, the zero momentum is the point where the Hitchin fiber intersects the Hitchin section. Such a family of Higgs bundles limits to the Hitchin section, thereby crossing to a lower stratum of the \BB stratification, an example of the phenomenon investigated in terms of Baker--Akhiezer divisors by the first author with Figiel and Teschner.
summary:
1. 作者借助秩二扭曲Higgs丛的谱对应，解析亏格二双曲晶体阿贝尔扇区最低朗道能级的简并跃变，将态和涡旋分别识别为Baker–Akhiezer截面及其零点。
2. 均匀场每晶胞含两个磁通量子时，零动量处简并度由一增至二，动量趋零等价于两涡旋趋于反演配对，趋近的复方向标记极限态射线。
3. 这还将非零动量态表示为共享布里渊区的四维平直晶体θ函数态的全纯限制，但零动量处该限制为零。

title: Finite-resource cooling of qudits beyond thermodynamic length
abstract: Cooling a quantum system with $N$ thermal machines costs more than Landauer's bound. For swap-based collision models the excess is set by thermodynamic length, which is optimal for qubits and was suggested by numerics to be optimal in general. We show that for qudits, permutations of energy eigenstates that use several resonant transitions at once do better for every spectrum, reducing the excess by up to 83% near the ground state. To second order, coherent collisions do no better, and at infinite temperature $d_M$-level machines reduce the excess by at most a factor $d_M-1$.
summary:
1. 针对N台热机冷却多能级系统时超出兰道尔界的耗散，作者以碰撞模型的二阶展开和数值优化建立共振置换生成的芬斯勒几何。
2. 并行布居转移降低热力学长度对应的1/N耗散系数，41台同维热机冷却近基态等间隔八能级系统时，额外耗散较最优交换协议减少83.3%。
3. 近无耗散碰撞中相干在二阶无额外优势，但多能级热机在无限温下已证的增益上界能否推广至任意温度仍待证明。

title: A Universal Approach to Hydrodynamics in Higher Dimensions via Tensor Networks
abstract: Extracting late-time hydrodynamic transport properties directly from microscopic quantum models, especially in dimensions beyond one, is believed to be classically intractable. This owes, in part, to the extensive growth of entanglement in higher dimensions and often a mismatch between geometric and tensor network locality. Here, we extend the Density Matrix Truncation (DMT) algorithm to accurately and quantitatively predict high-temperature transport coefficients (e.g. diffusion constants) in up to three dimensions. Additionally, we demonstrate the ability to capture the slow crossover dynamics characteristic of weakly broken integrability. The intuition underlying our approach is to preserve the geometrically local information crucial for hydrodynamics throughout the time evolution, despite using a one-dimensional matrix product state ansatz for higher-dimensional calculations. Our work pushes the boundary of classical computability and opens the door to benchmarking the high-temperature, late-time dynamics of generic quantum simulators.
summary:
1. 为计算高维量子体系的长时输运，作者提出晶格密度矩阵截断算法，在一维矩阵乘积算符截断中保留几何局域密度与流。
2. 该法外推出无限温二维混合场伊辛模型的能量扩散常数D=0.326±0.004，并在Jt≳80捕捉到耦合海森堡链由超扩散向扩散的漂移。
3. 该法可为高温量子模拟器提供经典输运基准，但三维结果尚限有限截面，有限温推广及非局域关联反馈对精度的影响仍需研究。

title: Fock-space delocalization and its control in scarred-vs-ergodic dynamics
abstract: Quantum many-body scarred dynamics in Rydberg-atom arrays is characterized by revivals, in which the system repeatedly returns to its initial state despite its many-body complexity. But how extensively does the wave function explore the space of allowed configurations between revivals? We address this question by quantifying the fraction of configurations occupied during PXP dynamics initialized from the paradigmatic polarized and Néel states, which respectively exhibit thermalizing and scarred dynamics. Despite their striking revivals, dynamics from the Néel state spreads over exponentially many configurations, yet occupies a vanishing fraction of the full space in the thermodynamic limit. Dynamics from the polarized state, by contrast, occupies a finite fraction of the configuration space, close to anticoncentration and random-state statistics, although chiral symmetry limits this fraction to one third. A weak quasiperiodic field enables the polarized state to occupy half of the configuration space by lifting the constraint imposed by chiral symmetry. The Néel state, however, requires a stronger field to reach a comparable anticoncentrated regime. As the field increases further, the occupied fraction decreases for both initial states, revealing a nonmonotonic dependence of Fock-space delocalization on field strength without necessarily implying localization.
summary:
1. 为量化疤痕复现间的构型扩展，作者用参与熵和有效占比数值比较里德伯阻塞链PXP模型中极化、尼尔初态的演化及准周期场响应。
2. 尼尔初态演化的有效构型数随链长指数增长而时间平均占比趋零；弱场破缺手征对称性使极化态占比由近1/3升至约1/2，尼尔态需耦合量级场才接近此值。

title: Beyond the Kubo formula: unification of adiabatic and isothermal response in quantum systems
abstract: The static limit of the Kubo susceptibility describes the adiabatic response of an isolated quantum system, in which energy-level occupations remain unchanged, and generally differs from the isothermal susceptibility, where these occupations readjust to thermal equilibrium. In this work, we introduce a single dynamical framework in which the adiabatic and isothermal responses arise naturally as two distinct limiting regimes. This can be done by considering explicitly an open system version of the Kubo approach in which the dissipation is governed by a typical thermalization rate of the system. By exchanging the order of the static limit and of the vanishing thermalization rate limit, the protocol yields either the adiabatic or isothermal response. This protocol has a solid physical motivation in terms of the thermalization dynamics and is valid for generic systems. We apply it to the case of the magnetic response of the electron gas and reproduce the expected results.
summary:
1. 为厘清能级占据冻结的量子绝热响应与等温响应之别，作者将热化率κ引入开放体系久保框架，并用格林函数计算耦合费米热浴的自由电子气磁响应。

3. 这一不依赖平移对称性的方案有望用于有限量子器件，但热化模型须遵守守恒律，孤立体系内部热化的响应尚待处理。

title: Electronic-Structure-Informed Many-Body Encoding for Quantum Machine Learning
abstract: Data encoding is a central challenge in quantum machine learning (QML), as it determines how classical information is mapped onto quantum states and influences the expressive power and efficiency of parameterized quantum circuits. Here, we introduce a physics-informed quantum encoding strategy that exploits the intrinsic many-body structure of electronic systems to establish a direct correspondence between the body order of input descriptors and the locality of quantum gates. Specifically, $n$-body electronic descriptors obtained from a single mean-field electronic-structure calculation are encoded through $n$-qubit gates, yielding a systematic hierarchy of quantum circuits with increasing many-body expressivity. Using reduced-density-matrix descriptors, we construct quantum machine-learning models incorporating one- through four-body encodings and benchmark their performance in predicting electron-correlation energies along bond-stretching potential energy surfaces. We demonstrate that increasing the body order of the encoding systematically improves prediction accuracy toward the full configuration interaction limit. Remarkably, disconnected many-particle densities constructed from lower-order electronic information achieve accuracy comparable to explicitly correlated two-particle densities in key cases, providing a computationally inexpensive route to higher-body quantum encodings. These findings establish a connection between the many-body structure of classical data and the design of quantum feature maps, offering a systematic, physically interpretable framework for enhancing the expressivity and predictive performance of quantum machine-learning circuits.

1. 为检验平均场信息能否支持电子关联能学习，作者由Hartree–Fock密度矩阵构造一至四体描述符，并映射至相应比特数的量子门。
2. 五种分子的最小基组键伸缩测试中，四体模型对FCI关联能的平均绝对误差为0.14–0.27毫哈特里，非连通二体编码与MP2相关密度编码精度相近。

title: Predictive Maintenance at the Edge: An Embedded Anomaly Detection Pipeline Trained with Quantum Optimization
abstract: This article presents a predictive-maintenance pipeline that detects anomalies in bearings from vibration signals, adapted for deployment at the edge on low-cost microcontrollers, and that uses quantum optimization in two steps of its training. The pipeline consists of a step of vibration feature extraction and a step of classification with a one-class support vector machine (OCSVM). The features are selected by minimum redundancy and maximum relevance (mRMR) with the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE), under a limit on computing time. The OCSVM is adapted for inference at the edge without floating-point operations and is trained by a variational quantum algorithm with Pauli-correlation encoding (PCE). In small-scale tests on a simulator, with the Paderborn bearing dataset, the VQE found the optimal selection in 36% of the runs with Adam, and PCE chose better support vectors than chance, until a classical local search made the two equal. A classical baseline, the usual OCSVM trained by SMO with its weights rounded, matched them without any search.
summary:
1. 针对边缘端轴承振动异常检测，作者在模拟器上用汉明重量守恒VQE求解预算约束特征选择，并以泡利关联编码训练支持整数推断的二值权重单类支持向量机。
2. 关联编码以16个量子比特表示320个训练变量，经经典局部搜索后F1为0.777，但经典松弛取整无需该搜索即达同等检测性能。
3. 研究未证明量子优势，边缘端开销仅经解析估计，后续可先经典松弛再量子优化残余变量，并开展真实硬件与跨工况验证。

title: Clifford synthesis is NP-complete
abstract: We show that the problem of synthesizing a quantum circuit for a given Clifford operator using at most a specified amount of resources is NP-complete for several resource models of practical interest. Specifically, we study synthesis of a given Clifford operator using single-qubit Clifford gates and two-qubit Clifford gates, with full qubit connectivity and no additional ancilla qubits. With single-qubit gates free and CNOT as the only two-qubit gate, we show that deciding whether a given target admits an implementation using at most a specified number of CNOT gates is NP-complete, and we show that the problem remains NP-complete when any two-qubit Clifford gate is allowed and the budget counts all such gates. Moreover, we show that both results continue to hold when SWAP gates may be inserted for free, and when single-qubit gates are also considered part of the budget. In each case, we build on recent work by Li and Guan and show that there are polynomial-time reductions from Hamiltonian path in grid graphs to these decision problems, using a number of qubits quadratic in the number of grid vertices.
summary:
1. 针对全连通、无额外辅助比特的Clifford门数优化，作者用辛空间计数与记录比特，将网格图哈密顿路径多项式归约为门预算判定。
2. 构造实例中免费单比特门无法提供捷径，CNOT预算判定为NP完全，结论还覆盖任意双比特Clifford门计数、免费SWAP及单比特门固定计费模型。
3. 这一最坏情形结论针对精确优化，并不排除高效非最优合成，近似优化与允许辅助比特的复杂性仍需另行研究。

title: Hypergraph cycle enumeration for efficient inference of planted k-XOR with smooth trade-off
abstract: We introduce hypergraph cycle enumeration (HCE), a simple spectral framework for detecting and recovering planted signals in noisy hypergraph inference problems. We study HCE on one representative problem from this class, namely planted noisy k-XOR, also known as sparse Learning Parity with Noise (LPN). Both theoretically and empirically, HCE achieves comparable recovery behavior to Kikuchi method, matching Kikuchi hierarchy. We identify parameter regimes where HCE outperforms Kikuchi method, showing that neither algorithm is universally better. We also show a subquadratic quantum speedup for HCE by replacing one of the algorithm's steps with a quantum walk. Our classical and quantum algorithms do not refute the quartic quantum speedup of quantum Kikuchi method, which remains valid for the practically relevant regime of large size and high noise strength.
summary:
1. 针对含噪k-XOR中隐藏信号的检测与恢复，作者枚举超图偶覆盖及双端见证，利用奇偶抵消将恢复化为n×n矩阵的谱估计。
2. 固定层级下检测界无对数损失，弱恢复界在忽略对数因子后匹配Kikuchi阈值曲线，有限规模超稀疏测试中恢复质量相近而耗时更低。
3. 归一化或裁剪有望去除恢复界的对数损失，而量子游走目前仅加速见证搜索，端到端恢复的量子优势仍待证明。

title: Variational Programs with Open Clocks
abstract: Variational quantum algorithms leave the durations of Hamiltonian evolutions open for a classical optimizer to set. We present VHamilton, a minimal extension of the Hamilton quantum programming language in which such durations are open clocks: one program denotes a family of Hamiltonian trajectories, and a valuation fills its clocks with exact dyadic times, so that each instance is an ordinary Hamilton program that compiles to circuits as before. Because the semantics stays exact and affine in the clocks, the Hamiltonian structure of a variational program remainsavail able for reasoning about every valuation at once. Equivalence becomes a finite calculation, which we mechanize in Agda for a fragment and use to prove the VHamilton form of the compiler rewrite "rzz(t) = cx; rz(t); cx" for every clock value. We then show what the same structure supports in a two-qubit chemistry eigensolver written in VHamilton and run through a Haskell prototype. It supports a fusion of commuting blocks, a closed form and an expressibility proof for the ansatz, and an exact split of the error between the precision of the target and that of the clocks, with a priori bounds. It also supports a coordinate search whose queries per sweep, fixed by the spectra of the generators, do not grow with the precision. On the benchmark this search reaches the numerically verified optimum of a grid of 134 million valuations in 53 energy queries. It finds the grid optimum in only 21 of 30 validation settings, however, so the gain is conditional, not a global-optimization guarantee.
summary:
1. 为验证演化时长未定的变分量子程序，作者构建开放时钟语言VHamilton，以精确二进有理数和泡利系数比较在Agda中核验部分哈密顿量重写。
2. 该表示支持目标舍入与时钟离散误差的分离及定界，谱驱动坐标搜索则在两量子比特分子模型的无噪声模拟中，以53次能量查询达到经数值穷举核验的1.34亿点网格最优。
3. 这些结构可支持精度规划与编译优化，但搜索在30组验证中仅21组找到网格最优，不具全局优化保证，含噪硬件表现仍待检验。

title: Quantum Vehicle Routing Problem: a smart initialization strategy for ill-conditioned optimization landscapes
abstract: With the expansion of complex transport infrastructure, new paths for linking different destinations have emerged, allowing the definition of multiple routes. The introduction of new roads may also lead to disruptions in traffic flow. This problem can be generalized into a special case of VRP, which aims to find the optimal route for a fleet of vehicles within a network of destinations. Finding solutions to this problem requires an exponential number of operations, hindering the ability of exact solvers to deal with large instances, which must therefore be tackled using heuristics, often leading to suboptimal results. Quantum-based algorithms may allow us to find exact solutions in polynomial time with high probability, offering a potential future alternative to classical solvers and in this work, we focus on the QAOA. Our novel contributions are a parameter-initialization strategy that improves the convergence probability and the integration of the subtour constraints directly into the optimization without using additional qubits by employing an approximation of exponential equality constraints. We believe that our results pave the way for effectively solving instances of VRP using quantum-based solutions, leveraging the space-efficient problem encoding and our initialization strategy, which limits the effect of barren-plateau under random parameter initialization.

1. 针对车辆路径问题中量子近似优化算法的训练困难与约束开销，作者在无噪声模拟中测试各层同角网格初始化及指数罚函数二阶近似编码。
2. 小规模对照中初始化优于随机起点，子回路约束无需额外量子比特，调参后四节点双车算例的最优解采样概率约95.06%。

title: Quantum query complexity of Hurwitz stability testing
summary:

title: Biorthogonal universal quantum control
abstract: As a paradigm for describing open-quantum-system dynamics, the non-Hermitian Schrödinger equation generally modifies state norms, complicating coherent control over the system's Hilbert space. With a general instantaneous frame spanned by biorthogonal ancillary bases, we develop a biorthogonal quantum-control theory for discrete-variable systems governed by time-dependent non-Hermitian Hamiltonian. In particular, we derive a necessary and sufficient condition for extracting the transitionless pathways that transport parallel in ket and bra states. When this condition is satisfied by a set of projectors constructed with biorthogonal basis states, the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian becomes diagonal in the relevant biorthogonal subspace, enabling arbitrary initial state to evolve as a superposition of controlled transitionless passages. We further identify the parametric constraints under which the transformation linking the initial and final states becomes unitary. As a result, the final system state is automatically normalized even though the transitional dynamics is nonunitary. Our theory is justified by the bidirectional population transfer and a holomonic quantum gate implemented by a non-Hermitian three-level system in $\Lambda$ type. For the population transfer, controlled gain and loss reduce the required coherent pulse area, enabling shorter transfer times than the Hermitian benchmark with the same average Rabi frequency. Our work integrates the universal quantum control (UQC) into the biorthogonal representation, displaying full-rank passage engineering with coherent operations in non-Hermitian systems.
summary:
